candidate_lemmas.name: EuclideanDomain
candidate_lemmas.statement:
class EuclideanDomain (R : Type u) extends CommRing R, Nontrivial R where
  /-- A division function (denoted `/`) on `R`.
    This satisfies the property `b * (a / b) + a % b = a`, where `%` denotes `remainder`. -/
  protected quotient : R → R → R
  /-- Division by zero should always give zero by convention. -/
  protected quotient_zero : ∀ a, quotient a 0 = 0
  /-- A remainder function (denoted `%`) on `R`.
    This satisfies the property `b * (a / b) + a % b = a`, where `/` denotes `quotient`. -/
  protected remainder : R → R → R
  /-- The property that links the quotient and remainder functions.
    This allows us to compute GCDs and LCMs. -/
  protected quotient_mul_add_remainder_eq : ∀ a b, b * quotient a b + remainder a b = a
  /-- A well-founded relation on `R`, satisfying `r (a % b) b`.
    This ensures that the GCD algorithm always terminates. -/
  protected r : R → R → Prop
  /-- The relation `r` must be well-founded.
    This ensures that the GCD algorithm always terminates. -/
  r_wellFounded : WellFounded r
  /-- The relation `r` satisfies `r (a % b) b`. -/
  protected remainder_lt : ∀ (a) {b}, b ≠ 0 → r (remainder a b) b
  /-- An additional constraint on `r`. -/
  mul_left_not_lt : ∀ (a) {b}, b ≠ 0 → ¬r (a * b) a

/-
Lean has far more theorems about fields than about Euclidean domains. We thus
lower the priority of `Euclideandomain.toCommRing`, encouraging typeclass inference
to try `Field.toCommRing` first. Without this priority-lowering, typeclass inference
finds the more inefficient path `Field.toEuclideanDomain.toCommRing` by default. This
priority change saves over 500G instructions across mathlib. See
https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/287929-mathlib4/topic/We.20need.20to.20talk.20about.20Euclidean.20Domains/near/594655420
-/

candidate_lemmas.statement:
structure RingCompute {u : Lean.Level} {α : Q(Type u)} (BaseType : Q($α) → Type)
  (sα : Q(CommSemiring $α)) extends RingCompare BaseType where
  /-- Evaluate the sum of two coefficents.

  If the result is zero returns a proof of this fact, which is used to remove zero terms. -/
  add {x y : Q($α)} : BaseType x → BaseType y →
    MetaM ((Result BaseType q($x + $y)) × (Option Q(IsNat ($x + $y) 0)))
  /-- Evaluate the product of two coefficents. -/
  mul {x y : Q($α)} : BaseType x → BaseType y → MetaM (Result BaseType q($x * $y))
  /-- Given a commutative ring `β` with a scalar multiplication action on `α` and a `x : β`, cast
  `x` to `α` such that the scalar multiplication turns into normal multiplication. Typically one
  can think of `α` as being an algebra over `β`, but this file does not know about `Algebra`s. -/
  cast (v : Lean.Level) (β : Q(Type v)) (_ : Q(CommSemiring $β))
      (_ : Q(SMul $β $α)) (x : Q($β)) :
    AtomM (Σ y : Q($α), ExSum BaseType sα q($y) × Q(∀ a : $α, $x • a = $y * a))
  /-- Evaluate the negation of a coefficient. -/
  neg {x : Q($α)} (rα : Q(CommRing $α)) : BaseType x → MetaM (Result BaseType q(-$x))
  /-- Raise a coefficient to some natural power.

  The exponent is not necessarily a natural literal. If the tactic can only raise coefficients to
  the power of a literal (e.g. `ring`), it should check for this and return `none` otherwise. -/
  pow {x : Q($α)} {b : Q(ℕ)} : BaseType x → (vb : ExProdNat q($b)) →
    OptionT MetaM (Result BaseType q($x ^ $b))
  /-- Evaluate the inverse of a coefficient. -/
  inv {x : Q($α)} (czα : Option Q(CharZero $α)) (fα : Q(Semifield $α)) : BaseType x →
    AtomM (Option <| Result BaseType q($x⁻¹))
  /-- Evaluate an expression as a potential coefficient. -/
  derive (x : Q($α)) : MetaM (Result (ExSum BaseType sα) q($x))
  /-- Decides whether a coefficient is 1 and returns a proof if so. -/
  isOne {x : Q($α)} : BaseType x → Option Q(NormNum.IsNat $x 1)
  /-- The number 1 represented as a BaseType. -/
  one : Result BaseType q((nat_lit 1).rawCast)

      = ∑ r ∈ Tset, ∑ m ∈ S, if P m r then F m r else 0 :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => Finset.sum_filter _ _

theorem LSeries_inverseTiltedDyadicWeightedPrimeWindow_eq_kernelSeries
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 3 / 2 < s.re) :

by

  have hdouble := summable_inverseTiltedDyadicDoubleTerm hs
  have hsigma : Summable
      (fun p : (n : ℕ) × ↥(Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n) =>
      inverseTiltedDyadicDoubleTerm s (e p)) := by
    exact e.summable_iff.mpr hdouble
  rw [LSeries]
  calc
    (∑' n : ℕ, LSeries.term
        (fun m => ((inverseTiltedDyadicWeightedPrimeWindow m : ℝ) : ℂ)) s n) =
        ∑' n : ℕ, ∑' p : ↥(Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n),

      apply tsum_congr
      intro n

    _ = ∑' p : (n : ℕ) × ↥(Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n),

        inverseTiltedDyadicDoubleTerm s (e ⟨n, p⟩)) = _
      rw [← hsigma.tsum_sigma]
    _ = ∑' kj : ℕ × ℕ, inverseTiltedDyadicDoubleTerm s kj :=
      e.tsum_eq (inverseTiltedDyadicDoubleTerm s)
    _ = ∑' k : ℕ, ∑' j : ℕ,
          inverseTiltedDyadicDoubleTerm s (k, j) := hdouble.tsum_prod
    _ = ∑' k : ℕ,
        ((((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k / Real.sqrt k) * k : ℝ) : ℂ)) *

source_arguments.statement:
theorem LSeries_lagCoeff_eq {θ M : ℝ} (hθ : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, (q.1 : ℂ).re ≤ θ)
    (hθ2 : 1 / 2 ≤ θ) {s : ℂ} (hs : θ - 1 / 2 < s.re) :
    LSeries (fun n => (primeLagCoeff M n : ℂ)) s
      = (M : ℂ) * (-logDeriv riemannZeta (1 + s))
        - ∑' q : XiZeroCopy, lagWeight q * (-logDeriv riemannZeta (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem LSeries_lagCoeff_eq {θ M : ℝ} (hθ : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, (q.1 : ℂ).re ≤ θ)
    (hθ2 : 1 / 2 ≤ θ) {s : ℂ} (hs : θ - 1 / 2 < s.re) :
    LSeries (fun n => (primeLagCoeff M n : ℂ)) s
      = (M : ℂ) * (-logDeriv riemannZeta (1 + s))
        - ∑' q : XiZeroCopy, lagWeight q * (-logDeriv riemannZeta (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hre1 : 1 < (1 + s).re := by
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith
  have h32 : ((3 : ℂ) / 2).re = 3 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hreq : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, 1 < (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)).re := fun q => by
    have := hθ q
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, h32]; linarith
  have hprod := summable_lagFam hθ hs
  have hrow : ∀ n, Summable fun q : XiZeroCopy =>
      lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n :=
    fun n => hprod.prod_factor n
  have hcol : ∀ q : XiZeroCopy, Summable fun n =>
      lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n :=
    fun q => (summable_term_vonMangoldtC (hreq q)).mul_left _
  have hfib : Summable fun n => ∑' q : XiZeroCopy,
      lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n :=
    (hprod.hasSum.prod_fiberwise fun n => (hrow n).hasSum).summable
  have hterm : ∀ n, LSeries.term (fun k => (primeLagCoeff M k : ℂ)) s n
      = (M : ℂ) * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (1 + s) n
        - ∑' q : XiZeroCopy, lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp [LSeries.term_zero]
    · exact lagCoeff_term_eq hn.ne'
  have hsumM : Summable fun n => (M : ℂ) * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (1 + s) n :=
    (summable_term_vonMangoldtC hre1).mul_left _
  have hswap := Summable.tsum_comm'
    (f := fun (n : ℕ) (q : XiZeroCopy) =>
      lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n) hprod hrow hcol
  calc LSeries (fun n => (primeLagCoeff M n : ℂ)) s
      = ∑' n, ((M : ℂ) * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (1 + s) n
          - ∑' q : XiZeroCopy, lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n) :=
        tsum_congr hterm
    _ = (M : ℂ) * ∑' n, LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (1 + s) n
          - ∑' n, ∑' q : XiZeroCopy,
              lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n := by
        rw [Summable.tsum_sub hsumM hfib, tsum_mul_left]
    _ = (M : ℂ) * (-logDeriv riemannZeta (1 + s))
          - ∑' q : XiZeroCopy, ∑' n,
              lagWeight q * LSeries.term vonMangoldtC (s + 3 / 2 - (q.1 : ℂ)) n := by
        rw [tsum_term_vonMangoldtC_eq hre1, hswap]
    _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        refine tsum_congr fun q => ?_
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_term_vonMangoldtC_eq (hreq q)]

theorem hasSum_shiftLatticeExpansion {C B : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a n‖ ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ B) (hd : 0 < d) (s z₀ ζ : ℂ)
    (hζ : ‖ζ‖ < z₀.im) :

      (thetaSeries a d s (z₀ + ζ))

theorem hasSum_shiftLatticeExpansion {C B : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a n‖ ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ B) (hd : 0 < d) (s z₀ ζ : ℂ)
    (hζ : ‖ζ‖ < z₀.im) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (shiftFactor * ζ) ^ k * shiftLatticeCoeff a d s z₀ k)
      (thetaSeries a d s (z₀ + ζ))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hzpos : 0 < z₀.im := lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg ζ) hζ
  have hsum := summable_shiftDouble ha hd s z₀ ζ hζ
  have hfib : ∀ n : ℕ, HasSum
      (fun k : ℕ => (shiftFactor * ζ) ^ k / (Nat.factorial k : ℂ)
        * thetaTerm a d (s - (k : ℂ) / (d : ℂ)) z₀ n)
      (thetaTerm a d s (z₀ + ζ) n) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp only [thetaTerm_zero, mul_zero]
      exact hasSum_zero
    · exact hasSum_thetaTerm_shift hn hd s z₀ ζ
  have htotal := hsum.hasSum.prod_fiberwise hfib
  have hval : (∑' p : ℕ × ℕ, (shiftFactor * ζ) ^ p.2 / (Nat.factorial p.2 : ℂ)
      * thetaTerm a d (s - (p.2 : ℂ) / (d : ℂ)) z₀ p.1)
      = thetaSeries a d s (z₀ + ζ) := htotal.tsum_eq.symm
  have hswap : HasSum (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (shiftFactor * ζ) ^ p.1
      / (Nat.factorial p.1 : ℂ)
      * thetaTerm a d (s - (p.1 : ℂ) / (d : ℂ)) z₀ p.2)
      (∑' p : ℕ × ℕ, (shiftFactor * ζ) ^ p.2 / (Nat.factorial p.2 : ℂ)
        * thetaTerm a d (s - (p.2 : ℂ) / (d : ℂ)) z₀ p.1) :=
    ((Equiv.prodComm ℕ ℕ).hasSum_iff).mpr hsum.hasSum
  have hfinal := hswap.prod_fiberwise
    (fun k => hasSum_shiftDouble_fiber ha hd s z₀ ζ hzpos k)
  rwa [hval] at hfinal

by
  unfold LSeries
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n = 0

  unfold cglShiftedDetectorProductCoefficient
  have hnC : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn

          (n : ℂ) ^ (-(s.1 + z)) := by
      congr 2
      ring
    _ = LSeries.convolution (cglTruncatedMobiusTwist X (q + 1) χ) (fun m : ℕ => χ m) n /

by
  set x := qGammaShiftPoint q s hs with hx
  have hz : x.z = 1 + s := rfl
  have hq : x.q = q := rfl
  set a : ℂ := (q.val : ℂ) ^ (1 + s) with hadef
  have ha : ‖a‖ < 1 := by
    have := x.denominatorDatum.a_norm_lt_one
    rw [EulerQGammaPoint.denominatorDatum] at this
    simpa [hz, hq, hadef] using this
  have hbin := qBinomial_hasSum q ha
  set K : ℂ := ((1 - q.val : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (1 - (1 + s)) * ((realQFactorialInf q : ℝ) : ℂ) with hK
  have hval : K * (qPochhammerInf a q.toEulerNome)⁻¹ = qGammaResponse q s hs := by
    rw [qGammaResponse, qGamma, qGammaCore, hK, hz, hq,
      qPochhammerInf_eq_realQFactorialInf q]
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [← hval]
  refine (hbin.mul_left K).congr_fun fun n => ?_
  -- termwise identification
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.val := q.pos
  have h1q : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - q.val := sub_pos.mpr q.lt_one
  have hfac : ((realQFactorial q n : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (realQFactorial_pos q n).ne'
  have hapow : a ^ n = ((q.val ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (s * (n : ℂ) * (Real.log q.val : ℂ)) := by
    rw [hadef, cpow_ofReal_pos hqpos, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    rw [show ((q.val ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * (Real.log q.val : ℂ)) by
      rw [← cpow_ofReal_pos hqpos, Complex.cpow_natCast]
      push_cast
      ring]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1

theorem routeUPrimeMoment_zero_eq {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 / 4 < X) :

theorem routeUPrimeMoment_zero_eq {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 / 4 < X) :

            (((1 / 2 + Real.sqrt X : ℝ)) : ℂ)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := by linarith
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt X := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hXpos
  rw [routeUPrimeMoment, LSeries, ← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simp [routeUPrimeTerm]
  have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hm1
  rw [routeUPrimeTerm, massPairing_cauchyFourierWeight_zero hXpos,
    LSeries.term_of_ne_zero (by omega)]
  have habs : |Real.log (m : ℝ)| = Real.log (m : ℝ) := abs_of_nonneg hlog
  rw [habs]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt X * Real.log (m : ℝ))) = (m : ℝ) ^ (-Real.sqrt X) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hmpos]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hpow : ((m : ℂ)) ^ (((1 / 2 + Real.sqrt X : ℝ)) : ℂ)
      = (((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt X) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow hmpos.le]
    norm_cast
  rw [hexp, hpow]
  have hsplit : (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 + Real.sqrt X) = Real.sqrt m * (m : ℝ) ^ (Real.sqrt X) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hmpos, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (m : ℝ)]
  have hne : Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hmpos
    exact ne_of_gt this
  have hne2 : ((m : ℝ) ^ (Real.sqrt X)) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) ^ (Real.sqrt X) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hmpos _
    exact ne_of_gt this
  rw [hsplit, ← Complex.ofReal_div, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [Real.rpow_neg hmpos.le]
  field_simp

    lSeriesSummable_degreeOneEulerPrimeFluxCoeff ha hs
  have hsupp : Function.support (LSeries.term (degreeOneEulerPrimeFluxCoeff a) s)
      ⊆ {n | IsPrimePow n} := by
    intro n hn
    by_contra hnp
    refine hn ?_
    rw [LSeries.term_def]
    split_ifs with h0
    · rfl
    · rw [degreeOneEulerPrimeFluxCoeff,
        degreeOneEulerFluxCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_isPrimePow _ hnp, zero_div]
  rw [LSeries, tsum_eq_tsum_primes_of_support_subset_prime_powers hsum hsupp, primeEulerFlux]
  refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
  have hz : ‖a p * ((p : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ < 1 := norm_prime_param_cpow_lt_one ha p hs
  have hterm : ∀ k : ℕ, LSeries.term (degreeOneEulerPrimeFluxCoeff a) s ((p : ℕ) ^ (k + 1))

    have hne : ((p : ℕ) ^ (k + 1)) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ p.property.pos.ne'

    simp only [dif_pos p.property, Subtype.coe_eta, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    ring

      = (a p * ((p : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-s)) / (1 - a p * ((p : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-s)) := by
    simp_rw [pow_succ']
    rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hz, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [tsum_mul_left, hgeom]

            blockDeletionCoefficient (p * q * r) n))

by
  have hpqr : Nat.Coprime (p * q) r := Nat.Coprime.mul_left hpr hqr
  have hp_qr : Nat.Coprime p (q * r) := Nat.Coprime.mul_right hpq hpr
  have hpq_id := blockDeletionCoefficient_mul_eq_add_sub_product_of_coprime hpq n
  have hpqr_id := blockDeletionCoefficient_mul_eq_add_sub_product_of_coprime hpqr n
  have hqr_id := blockDeletionCoefficient_mul_eq_add_sub_product_of_coprime hqr n

      blockDeletionCoefficient p n * blockDeletionCoefficient (q * r) n =

          blockDeletionCoefficient (p * q * r) n := by
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using
      blockDeletionCoefficient_mul_eq_add_sub_product_of_coprime hp_qr n
  rw [deletionFactorizationCurvatureCoefficient,
    blockDeletionCoefficient_sq_eq q n,
    blockDeletionCoefficient_sq_eq r n,
    blockDeletionCoefficient_sq_eq (q * r) n]
  push_cast

    (2 - (q : ℤ)) * hpq_id +
    (2 - (r : ℤ)) * hpqr_id -
    (2 - (r : ℤ)) * hqr_id -
    (2 - (q : ℤ) * (r : ℤ)) * hp_qr_id

source_arguments.statement:
partial def buildProof (arr : Array (Array Int)) (ctx ctx' : Expr)
    (steps : Array LRATStep) : MetaM Expr
source_arguments.source_statement:
partial def buildProof (arr : Array (Array Int)) (ctx ctx' : Expr)
    (steps : Array LRATStep) : MetaM Expr
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
do
  let p := mkApp (mkConst ``Sat.Fmla.subsumes_self) ctx
  let mut db := (buildClauses arr ctx 0 arr.size ctx' p default).2
  for step in steps do
    match step with
    | LRATStep.del ds => db := ds.foldl (·.erase ·) db
    | LRATStep.add i ns pf =>
      let e := buildClause ns
      match buildProofStep db ns pf ctx e with

  throwError "failed to prove empty clause"

/-- Build the type and value of the reified theorem. This rewrites all the SAT definitions
into standard operators on `Prop`, for example if the formula is `[[1, 2], [-1, 2], [-2]]` then
this produces a proof of `⊢ ∀ a b : Prop, (a ∧ b) ∨ (¬a ∧ b) ∨ ¬b`. We use the input `nvars` to
decide how many quantifiers to use.

Most of the proof is under `2 * nvars + 1` quantifiers
`a1 .. an : Prop, v : Valuation, h1 : v 0 ↔ a1, ... hn : v (n-1) ↔ an ⊢ ...`, and we do the index
arithmetic by hand.

  1. First, we call `reifyFormula ctx'` which returns `a` and `pr : reify v ctx' a`
  2. Then we build `fun (v : Valuation) (h1 : v 0 ↔ a1) ... (hn : v (n-1) ↔ an) ↦ pr`
  3. We have to lower expression `a` from step 1 out of the quantifiers by lowering all variable
     indices by `nvars+1`. This is okay because `v` and `h1..hn` do not appear in `a`.
  4. We construct the expression `ps`, which is `a1 .. an : Prop ⊢ [a1, ..., an] : List Prop`
  5. `refute ctx (hf : ctx.proof []) (fun v h1 .. hn ↦ pr) : a` forces some definitional unfolding
     since `fun h1 .. hn ↦ pr` should have type `implies v (reify v ctx a) [a1, ..., an] a`,
     which involves unfolding `implies` n times as well as `ctx ↦ ctx'`.
  6. Finally, we `intro a1 ... an` so that we have a proof of `∀ a1 ... an, a`.
-/

    deletionCoeffPartialSum q N = ((N % q : ℕ) : ℤ)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rw [deletionCoeffPartialSum]
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, blockDeletionCoefficient q (n + 1)) =
        (N : ℤ) - (q : ℤ) * ((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => q ∣ n + 1)).card := by
      simp only [blockDeletionCoefficient]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have hind :
          (∑ x ∈ Finset.range N, (q : ℤ) * if q ∣ x + 1 then 1 else 0) =
            ∑ x ∈ (Finset.range N).filter (fun n => q ∣ n + 1), (q : ℤ) := by
        simp_rw [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      rw [hind]
      simp [mul_comm]
    _ = (N : ℤ) - (q : ℤ) * (N / q : ℕ) := by rw [Nat.card_multiples]
    _ = (N % q : ℕ) := by
      have hnat : N % q + q * (N / q) = N := Nat.mod_add_div N q
      have hz : ((N % q : ℕ) : ℤ) + (q : ℤ) * (N / q : ℕ) = (N : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hnat
      omega

    rw [hpow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ n)) (fun n => q ∣ n)
  have hleft :
      (((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ n)).filter (fun n => ¬ q ∣ n)) =
        (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ insert q B, ¬ p ∣ n) := by
    ext n
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp]
    tauto
  have hright :
      (((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ n)).filter (fun n => q ∣ n)).card =
        freeCount B (x / q) := by
    have himg :
        (((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ n)).filter (fun n => q ∣ n)) =
          ((Finset.Icc 1 (x / q)).filter (fun m => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ m)).image (fun m => q * m) := by
      ext n
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc, mem_image]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hB⟩, m, rfl⟩
        have hm0 : 0 < m := by
          rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
          · simp at h1
          · exact hm
        refine ⟨m, ⟨⟨hm0, (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq).mpr (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact h2)⟩,
          ?_⟩, rfl⟩
        intro p hp hdvd
        exact hB p hp (hdvd.mul_left q)
      · rintro ⟨m, ⟨⟨hm1, hm2⟩, hmB⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨⟨⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity), ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩
        · calc q * m ≤ q * (x / q) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left q hm2
            _ ≤ x := Nat.mul_div_le x q
        · intro p hp hdvd
          exact hmB p hp ((Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (hcop p hp).symm) hdvd)
    rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b h => Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hq h)]
    rfl
  have hleftcard : (((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ n)).filter
      (fun n => ¬ q ∣ n)).card = freeCount (insert q B) x := by
    rw [hleft]
    rfl

  show _ = ((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ B, ¬ p ∣ n)).card
  omega

source_arguments.statement:
theorem coeff_pathSeries (x y : ℕ → ℝ) (X Y : A) (n k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (pathSeries x y X Y n) =
      wsum k (fun w => (pathCoef x y n w : ℂ) • evalWord X Y w)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem coeff_pathSeries (x y : ℕ → ℝ) (X Y : A) (n k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (pathSeries x y X Y n) =
      wsum k (fun w => (pathCoef x y n w : ℂ) • evalWord X Y w)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pathSeries_zero]
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [wsum_zero, pathCoef, evalWord]
    | succ k =>
      rw [show ((1 : PowerSeries A)) = PowerSeries.C 1 by simp, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
      simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false]
      rw [← wsum_zero_fun (M := A) (k+1)]
      refine wsum_congr _ (fun w hw => ?_)
      have hne : w ≠ [] := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hw; simp at hw
      simp [pathCoef, hne]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathSeries_succ, PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
      Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1),
        PowerSeries.coeff i (pathSeries x y X Y n) *
          PowerSeries.coeff (k-i) (expSeries ((x n : ℂ) • X + (y n : ℂ) • Y)) =
        wsum k (fun w => ((pathCoef x y n (w.take i) * segCoef (x n) (y n) (w.drop i) : ℝ) : ℂ)
          • evalWord X Y w) := by
      intro i hi
      have hik : i + (k - i) = k := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega
      rw [ih, coeff_expSeries_velocity, wsum_mul]
      calc wsum i (fun u => (pathCoef x y n u : ℂ) • evalWord X Y u *
              wsum (k-i) (fun v => (segCoef (x n) (y n) v : ℂ) • evalWord X Y v))
          = wsum i (fun u => wsum (k-i) (fun v =>
              ((pathCoef x y n u * segCoef (x n) (y n) v : ℝ) : ℂ) •
                evalWord X Y (u ++ v))) := by
            refine wsum_congr _ (fun u _ => ?_)
            rw [mul_wsum]
            refine wsum_congr _ (fun v _ => ?_)
            rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, evalWord_append]
            push_cast
            rfl
        _ = wsum i (fun u => wsum (k-i) (fun v =>
              (fun w => ((pathCoef x y n (w.take i) * segCoef (x n) (y n) (w.drop i) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
                evalWord X Y w) (u ++ v))) := by
            refine wsum_congr _ (fun u hu => ?_)
            refine wsum_congr _ (fun v hv => ?_)
            simp only []
            rw [List.take_left' hu, List.drop_left' hu]
        _ = wsum (i + (k-i)) (fun w =>
              ((pathCoef x y n (w.take i) * segCoef (x n) (y n) (w.drop i) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
                evalWord X Y w) :=
            wsum_append i (k-i) (fun w =>
              ((pathCoef x y n (w.take i) * segCoef (x n) (y n) (w.drop i) : ℝ) : ℂ) •
                evalWord X Y w)
        _ = wsum k _ := by rw [hik]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, wsum_finsetSum]
    refine wsum_congr _ (fun w hw => ?_)
    rw [pathCoef_succ, hw]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_smul]

    (hfa : HTGeometry.IsBohrAlmostPeriodic f) (hKc : Continuous K)
    (hKa : HTGeometry.IsBohrAlmostPeriodic K) (hK1 : bohrMean K = 1) (t : ℝ) :
    bohrMean (fun u => f (u + t) * K u) - f t
      = bohrMean fun u => (f (u + t) - f t) * K u
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hfct : Continuous fun u : ℝ => f (u + t) := hfc.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)

    isBohrAlmostPeriodic_comp_add_const hfa t
  have hconst : bohrMean (fun u => f t * K u) = f t := by
    rw [bohrMean_const_mul (f := K) (f t) hKc hKa, hK1, mul_one]
  have hsub : (fun u : ℝ => (f (u + t) - f t) * K u)
      = fun u : ℝ => f (u + t) * K u - f t * K u := funext fun u => by ring

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem mellin_salemFermiKernel_eq_gamma_mul_etaPair_of_one_lt_re
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    mellin salemFermiKernel s = Complex.Gamma s * etaPair s
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (-1 : ℂ) ^ n
  let p : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hp : ∀ n, a n = 0 ∨ 0 < p n := fun n => Or.inr (by
    dsimp [p]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n)
  have hF : ∀ t ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      HasSum (fun n => a n * Real.exp (-p n * t)) (salemFermiKernel t) := by
    intro t ht
    have h := salemFermiKernel_hasSum ht
    convert h using 1 with n
    funext n
    dsimp [a, p]
    have harg : -(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * t =
        -t - t * (n : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have harg' : -((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t)) =
        -t - t * (n : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [harg, harg']
  have hweight : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖ / p n ^ s.re) := by
    simpa [a, p] using salemFermi_weight_summable hs
  have hmellin : HasSum (fun n => Complex.Gamma s * a n / (p n : ℂ) ^ s)
      (mellin salemFermiKernel s) :=
    hasSum_mellin hp (by linarith) hF hweight
  rw [← hmellin.tsum_eq]
  calc
    (∑' n, Complex.Gamma s * a n / (p n : ℂ) ^ s) =
        ∑' n, Complex.Gamma s * (a n / (p n : ℂ) ^ s) := by
          apply tsum_congr
          intro n
          ring
    _ = Complex.Gamma s * ∑' n, a n / (p n : ℂ) ^ s := tsum_mul_left
    _ = Complex.Gamma s * etaPair s := by
      rw [show (∑' n, a n / (p n : ℂ) ^ s) =
          ∑' n : ℕ, (-1 : ℂ) ^ n / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ s) by rfl,
        tsum_salemAlternating_eq_etaPair hs]

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem σ_comp_P_eq_zero (X : SimplicialObject C) {n q : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : n + 1 ≤ i + q) :
    dsimp% X.σ i ≫ (P q).f (n + 1) = 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  induction q generalizing i with
  | zero => lia
  | succ q hq =>
    by_cases h : n + 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) + q
    · rw [P_succ, HomologicalComplex.comp_f, ← assoc, hq i h, zero_comp]
    · replace hi : n = i + q := by lia
      rcases n with _ | n
      · fin_cases i
        dsimp at h hi
        rw [show q = 0 by lia]
        change X.σ 0 ≫ (P 1).f 1 = 0
        simp only [P_succ, HomologicalComplex.add_f_apply, comp_add,
          AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj_d_eq, Hσ,
          HomologicalComplex.comp_f, Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'_f (c_mk 2 1 rfl) (c_mk 1 0 rfl),
          comp_id]
        rw [hσ'_eq' (zero_add 0).symm, hσ'_eq' (add_zero 1).symm]
        dsimp [P_zero]
        rw [comp_id, Fin.sum_univ_two,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, pow_one, pow_add, one_smul, neg_smul, Fin.val_succ,
          Fin.val_one, mul_neg, one_mul, neg_mul, neg_neg, id_comp, add_comp, comp_add, neg_comp,
          comp_neg, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
        rw [← Fin.castSucc_one, SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_self, ← Fin.castSucc_zero (n := 1),
          SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_self_assoc,
          SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_succ, comp_id, ← Fin.castSucc_zero (n := 2),
          ← Fin.succ_zero_eq_one,
          SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_of_le X
            (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ Fin.castSucc 0 by rw [Fin.castSucc_zero]),
          ← Fin.castSucc_zero (n := 1), SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_self_assoc,
          SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_succ_assoc]
        simp only [add_neg_cancel, add_zero, zero_add]
      · rw [← id_comp (X.σ i), ← (P_add_Q_f q n.succ : _ = 𝟙 (X.obj _)), add_comp, add_comp,
          P_succ]
        have v : HigherFacesVanish q ((P q).f n.succ ≫ X.σ i) :=
          (HigherFacesVanish.of_P q n).comp_σ hi
        dsimp only [AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj_X, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
          HomologicalComplex.add_f_apply, HomologicalComplex.id_f]
        rw [← assoc, v.comp_P_eq_self, Preadditive.comp_add,
          comp_id, v.comp_Hσ_eq hi, assoc, ← Fin.succ_mk _ _ i.2,
          SimplicialObject.δ_comp_σ_succ_assoc,
          Fin.eta, decomposition_Q n q, sum_comp, sum_comp, Finset.sum_eq_zero, add_zero,
          add_neg_eq_zero]
        intro j hj
        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.le.dest (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Fin.is_lt j))
        rw [add_comm] at hk
        have hi' : i = Fin.castSucc ⟨i, by lia⟩ := by
          ext

by
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  apply deningerRationalWittAdditiveMap_injective
    (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))
    (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective
  change deningerRationalWittAdditiveMap
      (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))
      (Additive.toMul
        (deningerPerfectRationalWittFromFixed K
          (deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K x + deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K y)).additiveVal) = _
  have hs := congrArg Additive.toMul
    (deningerPerfectRationalWittFromFixed_spec K
      (deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K x + deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K y))
  change deningerRationalWittAdditiveMap
      (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))
      (Additive.toMul
        (deningerPerfectRationalWittFromFixed K
          (deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K x + deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K y)).additiveVal) =
    Additive.toMul

        deningerRationalWittLiteralGaloisFixedSubring K) :
          DeningerRationalWittRing (AlgebraicClosure K)).additiveVal) at hs
  have hsub :

        deningerRationalWittLiteralGaloisFixedSubring K) :
          DeningerRationalWittRing (AlgebraicClosure K)).additiveVal) =
        (deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K x).1.additiveVal +
          (deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed K y).1.additiveVal :=
    deningerRationalWittRing_additiveVal_add _ _
  rw [hsub] at hs
  simpa [deningerPerfectRationalWittToFixed, deningerRationalWittPerfectBaseLift] using hs

source_arguments.name: GaloisForLFunctions.gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
source_arguments.statement:
theorem gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
    {n D τ : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) ℂ}
    {anchor : Fin (n + 2) →₀ ℕ}
    (haMax : ∀ m ∈ Q.support,
      jetMonomialDegree n m = D →
        magnitudeShiftCode n Q m ≤ magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor)
    {T : ℤ} {R : ℕ} {a : ℤ →₀ ℕ}
    (haFace : a ∈ gaussianOffsetFace D T R)
    (hpoly : polynomialPatternWeightPoly n D R τ Q
      (gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
        (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R) ≠ 0) :
    (((τ + magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ)) ≤ T
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
    {n D τ : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) ℂ}
    {anchor : Fin (n + 2) →₀ ℕ}
    (haMax : ∀ m ∈ Q.support,
      jetMonomialDegree n m = D →
        magnitudeShiftCode n Q m ≤ magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor)
    {T : ℤ} {R : ℕ} {a : ℤ →₀ ℕ}
    (haFace : a ∈ gaussianOffsetFace D T R)
    (hpoly : polynomialPatternWeightPoly n D R τ Q
      (gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
        (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R) ≠ 0) :
    (((τ + magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ)) ≤ T
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let p := gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
    (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R
  have hpcount : (∑ r, (p r : ℕ)) = D := by
    simpa only [p] using gaussianOffsetPatternWindow_count haFace
  have hpSurvivor : p ∈ polynomialPatternSurvivors n D R τ Q (2 * R + 1) := by
    rw [polynomialPatternSurvivors, degreeDPolynomialPatterns,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨⟨Finset.mem_univ p, hpcount⟩, by simpa only [p] using hpoly⟩
  have hfloor := polynomialPattern_source_floor_of_survivor
    haMax hpSurvivor
  have hfloorInt :
      (D : ℤ) * (R : ℤ) + (τ : ℤ) +
          (magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℤ) ≤
        (polynomialPatternSourceSum p : ℤ) +
          (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfloor
  have hsource :
      (polynomialPatternSourceSum p : ℤ) - (R : ℤ) * (D : ℤ) = T := by
    simpa only [p] using gaussianOffsetPatternWindow_source haFace
  push_cast
  rw [← hsource]
  nlinarith [hfloorInt]

source_arguments.statement:
theorem cglFibreSeparatedPacket_sameCharacter_separation {q R : ℕ}
    (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R) (r s : Fin R) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (hchar : P.character r = P.character s) :
    P.spacing ≤ |P.ordinate r - P.ordinate s|
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem cglFibreSeparatedPacket_sameCharacter_separation {q R : ℕ}
    (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R) (r s : Fin R) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (hchar : P.character r = P.character s) :
    P.spacing ≤ |P.ordinate r - P.ordinate s|
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hrank : P.fibreRank r ≠ P.fibreRank s :=
    fun heq => hrs (P.fibreRank_injective hchar heq)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hrank with hlt | hgt
  · have hspread := RHTower.Sieve.le_of_gap (P.fibreTime_step (P.character r))
      (P.fibreRank r) (P.fibreRank s) (le_of_lt hlt)
    have hunit : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (P.fibreRank s : ℝ) - P.fibreRank r := by
      have : (P.fibreRank r : ℝ) + 1 ≤ P.fibreRank s := by exact_mod_cast hlt
      linarith
    have hmul : P.spacing ≤ ((P.fibreRank s : ℝ) - P.fibreRank r) * P.spacing := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hunit (le_of_lt P.spacing_pos)
    have hstep : P.fibreTime (P.character r) (P.fibreRank r) + P.spacing ≤
        P.fibreTime (P.character r) (P.fibreRank s) := by
      linarith
    rw [P.ordinate_eq_fibreTime r, P.ordinate_eq_fibreTime s, ← hchar]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [P.spacing_pos])]
    linarith
  · have hspread := RHTower.Sieve.le_of_gap (P.fibreTime_step (P.character s))
      (P.fibreRank s) (P.fibreRank r) (le_of_lt hgt)
    have hunit : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (P.fibreRank r : ℝ) - P.fibreRank s := by
      have : (P.fibreRank s : ℝ) + 1 ≤ P.fibreRank r := by exact_mod_cast hgt
      linarith
    have hmul : P.spacing ≤ ((P.fibreRank r : ℝ) - P.fibreRank s) * P.spacing := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hunit (le_of_lt P.spacing_pos)
    have hstep : P.fibreTime (P.character s) (P.fibreRank s) + P.spacing ≤
        P.fibreTime (P.character s) (P.fibreRank r) := by
      linarith
    have hstep' : P.fibreTime (P.character r) (P.fibreRank s) + P.spacing ≤
        P.fibreTime (P.character r) (P.fibreRank r) := by
      simpa only [hchar] using hstep
    rw [P.ordinate_eq_fibreTime r, P.ordinate_eq_fibreTime s, ← hchar]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hstep', P.spacing_pos])]
    linarith [hstep']

    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      ((gaussLocalFactorWeight 3 p : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,

                (fourierLp 2 ((n : ℤ) + 1))) : ℂ) +

              ((gaussQuasiInnerGFull (by omega : 1 ≤ 3) k p ^ 3)
                (fourierLp 2 (-((n : ℤ) + 1)))))) / (Real.log N : ℂ)))
      atTop (nhds ((gaussChannelResidue 3 p : ℝ) : ℂ))

    have hunit : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (P.fibreRank r : ℝ) - P.fibreRank s := by

source_arguments.statement:
theorem powerSeries_eq_one_of_unbounded_roots {F : PowerSeries ℤ}
    (hF : PowerSeries.constantCoeff F = 1)
    (hroot : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ ∃ G : PowerSeries ℤ,
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff G = 1 ∧ G ^ n = F) :
    F = 1
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem powerSeries_eq_one_of_unbounded_roots {F : PowerSeries ℤ}
    (hF : PowerSeries.constantCoeff F = 1)
    (hroot : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ ∃ G : PowerSeries ℤ,
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff G = 1 ∧ G ^ n = F) :
    F = 1
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  by_contra hne
  have hH0 : F - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
  set k := (F - 1).order.toNat with hkdef
  have hcoeffk : PowerSeries.coeff k (F - 1) ≠ 0 := PowerSeries.coeff_order hH0
  have hdvd : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ n ∧ (n : ℤ) ∣ PowerSeries.coeff k (F - 1) := by
    intro N
    obtain ⟨n, hn, G, hG1, hGpow⟩ := hroot (max N 1)
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right N 1) hn
    refine ⟨n, le_trans (le_max_left N 1) hn, ?_⟩
    set K := G - 1 with hKdef
    have hGK : G = K + 1 := by rw [hKdef]; ring
    have hK1 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff K = 0 := by
      rw [hKdef, map_sub, hG1, map_one, sub_self]
    have hK0 : K ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      refine hne ?_
      rw [← hGpow, hGK, h, zero_add, one_pow]
    set l := K.order.toNat with hldef
    have hl1 : 1 ≤ l := one_le_order_toNat hK0 hK1
    have hcoeffl : PowerSeries.coeff l K ≠ 0 := PowerSeries.coeff_order hK0
    have hkey : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ l →
        PowerSeries.coeff j F = (n : ℤ) * PowerSeries.coeff j K := by
      intro j hj1 hjl
      rw [← hGpow, hGK, coeff_add_one_pow]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
      · simp [Nat.choose_one_right]
      · intro i _ hi1
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hipos
        · rw [pow_zero, PowerSeries.coeff_one, if_neg (by omega), mul_zero]
        · have hi2 : 2 ≤ i := by omega
          rw [coeff_pow_eq_zero_of_lt hK0 hipos ?_, mul_zero]
          calc j ≤ l := hjl
            _ < 2 * l := by omega
            _ ≤ i * l := Nat.mul_le_mul_right l hi2
      · intro hcon
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)) hcon
    have hHj : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → PowerSeries.coeff j (F - 1) = PowerSeries.coeff j F := by
      intro j hj
      rw [map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_one, if_neg (by omega), sub_zero]
    have hlow : ∀ j : ℕ, j < l → PowerSeries.coeff j (F - 1) = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj0
      · rw [map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hF, map_one, sub_self]
      · rw [hHj j hj0, hkey j hj0 (le_of_lt hj)]
        have : PowerSeries.coeff j K = 0 := by
          refine PowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order j ?_
          rw [← order_toNat_cast hK0]
          exact_mod_cast hj
        rw [this, mul_zero]
    have hlval : PowerSeries.coeff l (F - 1) = (n : ℤ) * PowerSeries.coeff l K := by
      rw [hHj l hl1, hkey l hl1 le_rfl]
    have hlne : PowerSeries.coeff l (F - 1) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hlval]
      exact mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (by omega)) hcoeffl
    have hkl : k = l := by
      have hge : (l : ℕ∞) ≤ (F - 1).order := by
        refine PowerSeries.le_order _ _ ?_
        intro j hj
        exact hlow j (by exact_mod_cast hj)
      have hle : (F - 1).order ≤ (l : ℕ∞) := PowerSeries.order_le _ hlne
      have : (F - 1).order = (l : ℕ∞) := le_antisymm hle hge
      rw [hkdef, this]
      simp
    rw [hkl, hlval]
    exact ⟨PowerSeries.coeff l K, rfl⟩
  exact hcoeffk (int_eq_zero_of_unbounded_natCast_dvd _ hdvd)

source_arguments.statement:
theorem card_rows_all_boundedCoefficientPolynomialsOver_zero_le
    {K row κ : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Fintype row] [DecidableEq row]
    (q : ℕ) (z : row → K) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (c : κ × Fin (q + 1) → K) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Set.ncard {b | ∀ a, ∑ d, c (a, d) * z b ^ (d : ℕ) = 0} ≤ q
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem card_rows_all_boundedCoefficientPolynomialsOver_zero_le
    {K row κ : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Fintype row] [DecidableEq row]
    (q : ℕ) (z : row → K) (hz : Function.Injective z)
    (c : κ × Fin (q + 1) → K) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Set.ncard {b | ∀ a, ∑ d, c (a, d) * z b ^ (d : ℕ) = 0} ≤ q
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ a d, c (a, d) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hc
    funext x
    exact h x.1 x.2
  obtain ⟨a, d, had⟩ := hex
  let P : Polynomial K := boundedCoefficientPolynomialOver q (fun e => c (a, e))
  have hP : P ≠ 0 := boundedCoefficientPolynomialOver_ne_zero_of_apply_ne_zero q _ had
  let bad : Finset row := Finset.univ.filter fun b =>
    ∀ a, ∑ d, c (a, d) * z b ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  have hbadCard :
      Set.ncard {b | ∀ a, ∑ d, c (a, d) * z b ^ (d : ℕ) = 0} = bad.card := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
    congr 1
    ext b
    simp [bad]
  have himage : Finset.image z bad ⊆ P.roots.toFinset := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hP]
    rw [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, boundedCoefficientPolynomialOver_eval]
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2 a
  have hcard : bad.card = (Finset.image z bad).card := by
    symm
    exact Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hz.injOn
  rw [hbadCard]
  calc
    bad.card = (Finset.image z bad).card := hcard
    _ ≤ P.roots.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card himage
    _ ≤ P.roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le P.roots
    _ ≤ P.natDegree := Polynomial.card_roots' P
    _ ≤ q := boundedCoefficientPolynomialOver_natDegree_le q _

theorem orderedDeterminant_summable
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) {a M : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a, ‖K x y‖ ≤ M)

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem orderedDeterminant_summable
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) {a M : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a, ∀ y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) a, ‖K x y‖ ≤ M)

by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded
    (summable_hadamard_majorant (‖z‖ * (a * M))

  intro n
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  calc
    ‖z‖ ^ n * ‖orderedFredholmCoefficient K a n‖
        ≤ ‖z‖ ^ n * ((Real.sqrt n * (a * M)) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
          gcongr
          exact orderedFredholmCoefficient_norm_le K ha hM hK n
    _ = (Real.sqrt n * (‖z‖ * (a * M))) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) := by ring

          ∑ᶠ (k : ℤ) (_ : k ≠ 0),
            F ((k : ℚ) / ((c * m : ℕ) : ℚ)) * quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * m) h k =
      ∑ r ∈ N.divisors,
          ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius r : ℂ) / ((c * r : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
            (∏ p ∈ (N / r).primeFactors,
              (1 - (quadraticCongruenceRootCountTotal p h : ℂ) / (p : ℂ))) *
            ∑ᶠ (u : ℤ) (_ : u ≠ 0 ∧ (u.natAbs).Coprime r),

                quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * r) h u

            ∑ᶠ (u : ℤ) (_ : u ≠ 0 ∧ (u.natAbs).Coprime r),

by

  -- the frequency weight attached to a fixed modulus has finite support

    have hn' : ((n : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℤ => (k : ℚ) / ((n : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
      intro a b hab
      simp only at hab
      rw [div_eq_div_iff hn' hn'] at hab
      exact_mod_cast mul_right_cancel₀ hn' hab
    refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.preimage hinj.injOn hF) ?_
    intro k hk
    have : F ((k : ℚ) / ((n : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact hk (by simp [h0])

      (∑ᶠ (k : ℤ) (_ : k ≠ 0),
          F ((k : ℚ) / ((c * m : ℕ) : ℚ)) * quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * m) h k) =
        ∑ d ∈ m.divisors,
          ∑ᶠ (u : ℤ) (_ : u ≠ 0 ∧ (u.natAbs).Coprime (m / d)),
            F (((u * d : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((c * m : ℕ) : ℚ)) *
              quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * m) h (u * d) := by
    intro m hm
    have hmsq : Squarefree m := hN.squarefree_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hm)
    exact finsum_nonzero_eq_sum_divisors_finsum hmsq _
      (hsupp (c * m) (Nat.mul_ne_zero hc hmsq.ne_zero))

    (fun m d => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius m : ℂ) / ((c * m : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
      ∑ᶠ (u : ℤ) (_ : u ≠ 0 ∧ (u.natAbs).Coprime (m / d)),
        F (((u * d : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((c * m : ℕ) : ℚ)) *
          quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * m) h (u * d))]

  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hr).ne'

      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (r * d) : ℂ) / ((c * (r * d) : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
          (∑ᶠ (u : ℤ) (_ : u ≠ 0 ∧ (u.natAbs).Coprime ((r * d) / d)),
            F (((u * d : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((c * (r * d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) *
              quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * (r * d)) h (u * d)) =
        (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius r : ℂ) / ((c * r : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
            ∑ᶠ (u : ℤ) (_ : u ≠ 0 ∧ (u.natAbs).Coprime r),
              F ((u : ℚ) / ((c * r : ℕ) : ℚ)) *
                quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (c * r) h u) *
          ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℂ) *
            ((quadraticCongruenceRootCountTotal d h : ℂ) / (d : ℂ))) := by
    intro d hd
    have hdq : d ∣ N / r := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd).ne'
    have hrd : r * d ∣ N := (Nat.dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hrN).mp hdq
    have hrdsq : Squarefree (r * d) := hN.squarefree_of_dvd hrd

    have hcm : c.Coprime (r * d) := hcN.coprime_dvd_right hrd

theorem moebius_mul_primeFreeDivisorIncrementAF :

        (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) +
        algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ)

    (ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) *
        primeFreeDivisorIncrementAF =

        (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) +
        algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
          (2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)

  let c : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
    algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)
  have hc : (ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * c *
      (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) = c := by
    calc
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * c *
          (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) =
          c * ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) *
            (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = c := by rw [ArithmeticFunction.coe_moebius_mul_coe_zeta, mul_one]

    ArithmeticFunction.moebius_mul_log_eq_vonMangoldt,
    ← mul_assoc, ArithmeticFunction.coe_moebius_mul_coe_zeta,
    one_mul]

      (algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
        (2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)) *
        (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) =
      algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
        (2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) := by
    simpa only [c] using hc
  rw [← mul_assoc, hc']

source_arguments.statement:
theorem quadraticCongruence_reducedFrequencyAliasCollapse
    {q N : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hN : Squarefree N) (hqN : q.Coprime N)
    (h a : ℤ) :
    ∑ d ∈ N.divisors,
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q * d) : ℂ) / ((q * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
          quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (q * d) h (a * d) =
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) / (q : ℂ)) *
        quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal q h a *
          ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors,
            (1 - (quadraticCongruenceRootCountTotal p h : ℂ) / (p : ℂ))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem quadraticCongruence_reducedFrequencyAliasCollapse
    {q N : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hN : Squarefree N) (hqN : q.Coprime N)
    (h a : ℤ) :
    ∑ d ∈ N.divisors,
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q * d) : ℂ) / ((q * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
          quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (q * d) h (a * d) =
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) / (q : ℂ)) *
        quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal q h a *
          ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors,
            (1 - (quadraticCongruenceRootCountTotal p h : ℂ) / (p : ℂ))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ N.divisors,
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q * d) : ℂ) / ((q * d : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
          quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal (q * d) h (a * d) =
        (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) / (q : ℂ)) *
          quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal q h a) *
            ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℂ) *
              ((quadraticCongruenceRootCountTotal d h : ℂ) / (d : ℂ))) := by
    intro d hd
    have hdvd : d ∣ N := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd).ne'
    have hcop : q.Coprime d := hqN.coprime_dvd_right hdvd
    rw [quadraticCongruenceRootSumTotal_mul_alias hq hd0 hcop h a]
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_moebius.map_mul_of_coprime hcop]
    push_cast
    field_simp [hq, hd0]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d hd => hterm d hd), ← Finset.mul_sum,
    quadraticCongruenceRootDensity_squarefree_euler hN h]

theorem thetaSquareFiniteReaderValue_eq_blaschkeFinite
    {n N : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hxnode : (x : ℂ) ≠ thetaSquare n) :
    thetaSquareFiniteReaderValue n N x =
      (thetaSquareBlaschkeNodeSlope n)⁻¹ * thetaSquareBlaschkeFinite N x /
        ((x : ℂ) - thetaSquare n)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem thetaSquareFiniteReaderValue_eq_blaschkeFinite
    {n N : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hxnode : (x : ℂ) ≠ thetaSquare n) :
    thetaSquareFiniteReaderValue n N x =
      (thetaSquareBlaschkeNodeSlope n)⁻¹ * thetaSquareBlaschkeFinite N x /
        ((x : ℂ) - thetaSquare n)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let z : ℂ := x
  have htheta : thetaSquare n = (n : ℂ) ^ 2 := by simp [thetaSquare]
  have hminus : z - (n : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← htheta, sub_ne_zero]
    exact hxnode
  have hplus : (n : ℂ) ^ 2 + z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    dsimp [z] at hre
    norm_num [pow_two] at hre
    nlinarith [hx]
  let S : ℂ := (thetaSquareBlaschkeNodeSlope n)⁻¹
  let P : ℂ := thetaSquareFiniteSkippedProduct n N z
  have hsplit := thetaSquareBlaschkeFinite_split_selected hn hnN z
  calc
    thetaSquareFiniteReaderValue n N x =
        (-S * ((n : ℂ) ^ 2 + z)⁻¹) * P := by rfl
    _ = S * ((((n : ℂ) ^ 2 - z) / ((n : ℂ) ^ 2 + z)) * P) /
        (z - (n : ℂ) ^ 2) := cancel_selected_blaschke_factor hminus hplus
    _ = S * thetaSquareBlaschkeFinite N z / (z - (n : ℂ) ^ 2) := by rw [hsplit]
    _ = (thetaSquareBlaschkeNodeSlope n)⁻¹ * thetaSquareBlaschkeFinite N z /
        (z - thetaSquare n) := by rw [htheta]

theorem bourgainParabolaMomentCode_injective_on_image
    {H : ℕ} {y z : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hy : y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin H)).image
      bourgainParabolaTripleMoment)
    (hz : z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin H)).image
      bourgainParabolaTripleMoment)
    (hcode :
      bourgainParabolaMomentCode H y =
        bourgainParabolaMomentCode H z) :

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem bourgainParabolaMomentCode_injective_on_image
    {H : ℕ} {y z : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hy : y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin H)).image
      bourgainParabolaTripleMoment)
    (hz : z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Fin H)).image
      bourgainParabolaTripleMoment)
    (hcode :
      bourgainParabolaMomentCode H y =
        bourgainParabolaMomentCode H z) :
    y = z
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  obtain ⟨h, -, hhy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
  obtain ⟨k, -, hkz⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
  have hylt : y.1 < bourgainParabolaMomentBase H := by
    rw [← hhy]
    exact bourgainParabolaTripleMoment_fst_lt_base h
  have hzlt : z.1 < bourgainParabolaMomentBase H := by
    rw [← hkz]
    exact bourgainParabolaTripleMoment_fst_lt_base k
  have hfst : y.1 = z.1 := by
    have hmod := congrArg
      (fun n : ℕ => n % bourgainParabolaMomentBase H) hcode
    simpa [bourgainParabolaMomentCode,
      Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hylt,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hzlt] using hmod
  have hsndMul :
      bourgainParabolaMomentBase H * y.2 =
        bourgainParabolaMomentBase H * z.2 := by
    simpa [bourgainParabolaMomentCode, hfst] using hcode
  have hsnd : y.2 = z.2 :=
    Nat.mul_left_cancel (by
      simp [bourgainParabolaMomentBase]) hsndMul
  exact Prod.ext hfst hsnd

frequencies. -/

source_arguments.statement:
private theorem weightedLambertMobius_antidiagonal
    (a : ℕ+ → ℂ) (b : ℕ+) :
    (∑ x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal,
      weightedLambertMobiusPair a (divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x)) =
      if b = 1 then a 1 else 0
source_arguments.source_statement:
private theorem weightedLambertMobius_antidiagonal
    (a : ℕ+ → ℂ) (b : ℕ+) :
    (∑ x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal,
      weightedLambertMobiusPair a (divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x)) =
      if b = 1 then a 1 else 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  have hterm (x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal) :
      weightedLambertMobiusPair a (divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x) =
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius x.1.1 : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) * a b := by
    let d := divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x
    have hval : d.1.1 * d.2.1 = (b : ℕ) :=
      divisorsAntidiagonalFactors_eq x
    have hprod : d.1 * d.2 = b := Subtype.ext hval
    change (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d.1 : ℂ) * (d.1 : ℂ) * (d.2 : ℂ) *
      a (d.1 * d.2) = _
    rw [hprod]
    have hcast : (d.1 : ℂ) * (d.2 : ℂ) = (b : ℂ) := by
      change ((d.1.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((d.2.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((b.1 : ℕ) : ℂ)
      exact_mod_cast hval
    rw [show (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d.1 : ℂ) * (d.1 : ℂ) * (d.2 : ℂ) =
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d.1 : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) by
      rw [mul_assoc, hcast]]
    rfl
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  have hmuC :
      (∑ x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal,
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius x.1.1 : ℂ)) =
        if b = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [← Int.cast_sum, sum_moebius_first_divisorsAntidiagonal b]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hmuC]
  split_ifs with hb
  · subst b
    norm_num
  · simp

source_arguments.statement:
private theorem primeDensityMobius_antidiagonal
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (b : ℕ+) :
    (∑ x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal,
      primeDensityMobiusPair g u (divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x)) =

    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (b : ℕ+) :
    (∑ x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal,
      primeDensityMobiusPair g u (divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x)) =
      if b = 1 then g u else 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  have hterm (x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal) :
      primeDensityMobiusPair g u (divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x) =
        (moebius x.1.2 : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * g (u / b) := by
    let d := divisorsAntidiagonalFactors b x
    have hval : d.1.1 * d.2.1 = (b : ℕ) :=
      divisorsAntidiagonalFactors_eq x
    have hprod : d.1 * d.2 = b := Subtype.ext hval
    have hcast : (d.1 : ℝ) * (d.2 : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) := by
      change ((d.1.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((d.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        ((b.1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      exact_mod_cast hval
    change
      1 / (d.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ((moebius d.2 : ℝ) / (d.2 : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            g (u / ((d.1 : ℝ) * (d.2 : ℝ)))) =
        (moebius d.2 : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * g (u / b)
    have hd1 : (d.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hd2 : (d.2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hb : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    calc
      1 / (d.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ((moebius d.2 : ℝ) / (d.2 : ℝ) ^ 2 *
              g (u / ((d.1 : ℝ) * (d.2 : ℝ)))) =
          (moebius d.2 : ℝ) /
              ((d.1 : ℝ) * (d.2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
            g (u / ((d.1 : ℝ) * (d.2 : ℝ))) := by
              field_simp
      _ = (moebius d.2 : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ 2 * g (u / b) := by
        rw [hcast]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_div]
  have hmuR :
      (∑ x : (b : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal, (moebius x.1.2 : ℝ)) =
        if b = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [← Int.cast_sum, sum_moebius_second_divisorsAntidiagonal b]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hmuR]
  split_ifs with hb

    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ+) :
    (∑' n : ℕ+, mobiusLaplaceLambertPair x (k, n)) =
      mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform ((k : ℝ) * x)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hkx : 0 < (k : ℝ) * x := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast k.property) hx
  have hsum := summable_mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTerm hkx
  have hsplit := hsum.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  calc
    (∑' n : ℕ+, mobiusLaplaceLambertPair x (k, n)) =
        ∑' n : ℕ+, mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTerm ((k : ℝ) * x) (n : ℕ) := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro n
      rw [mobiusLaplaceLambertPair, mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTerm]
      apply congrArg (fun z : ℂ =>
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℂ) * z)
      apply congrArg Complex.exp
      push_cast
      ring
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTerm ((k : ℝ) * x) (n + 1) := by
      exact tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ
    _ = mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform ((k : ℝ) * x) := by
      rw [mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform]
      simpa [mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTerm] using hsplit

source_arguments.name: RHTower.tsum_moebius_pair
source_arguments.statement:
theorem tsum_moebius_pair {F : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hsummable : Summable fun x : ℕ+ × ℕ+ =>
      (moebius (x.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * F ((x.1 : ℕ) * (x.2 : ℕ))) :
    (∑' x : ℕ+ × ℕ+, (moebius (x.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * F ((x.1 : ℕ) * (x.2 : ℕ))) = F 1
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem tsum_moebius_pair {F : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hsummable : Summable fun x : ℕ+ × ℕ+ =>
      (moebius (x.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * F ((x.1 : ℕ) * (x.2 : ℕ))) :
    (∑' x : ℕ+ × ℕ+, (moebius (x.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * F ((x.1 : ℕ) * (x.2 : ℕ))) = F 1
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  set G : ℕ+ × ℕ+ → ℂ := fun x => (moebius (x.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * F ((x.1 : ℕ) * (x.2 : ℕ)) with hG
  have hpull : (∑' x : ℕ+ × ℕ+, G x)
      = ∑' p : (Σ m : ℕ+, Nat.divisorsAntidiagonal (m : ℕ)), G (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd p) :=
    (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd.tsum_eq G).symm
  have hsummableG : Summable fun p : (Σ m : ℕ+, Nat.divisorsAntidiagonal (m : ℕ)) =>
      G (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd p) :=
    (Equiv.summable_iff sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd).mpr hsummable
  have hsigma : (∑' p : (Σ m : ℕ+, Nat.divisorsAntidiagonal (m : ℕ)),
        G (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd p))
      = ∑' m : ℕ+, ∑' q : Nat.divisorsAntidiagonal (m : ℕ),
          G (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd ⟨m, q⟩) := hsummableG.tsum_sigma
  have hinner : ∀ m : ℕ+, (∑' q : Nat.divisorsAntidiagonal (m : ℕ),
      G (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd ⟨m, q⟩)) = (if (m : ℕ) = 1 then F (m : ℕ) else 0) := by
    intro m
    have hterm : ∀ q : Nat.divisorsAntidiagonal (m : ℕ),
        G (sigmaAntidiagonalEquivProd ⟨m, q⟩) = (moebius (q.1.1) : ℂ) * F (m : ℕ) := by
      intro q
      have hprod : ((divisorsAntidiagonalFactors m q).1 : ℕ)
          * ((divisorsAntidiagonalFactors m q).2 : ℕ) = (m : ℕ) :=
        divisorsAntidiagonalFactors_eq q
      have hfst : ((divisorsAntidiagonalFactors m q).1 : ℕ) = q.1.1 := rfl
      show (moebius ((divisorsAntidiagonalFactors m q).1 : ℕ) : ℂ)
          * F (((divisorsAntidiagonalFactors m q).1 : ℕ)
            * ((divisorsAntidiagonalFactors m q).2 : ℕ)) = _
      rw [hprod, hfst]
    rw [tsum_congr hterm, Finset.tsum_subtype ((m : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal)
      (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => (moebius q.1 : ℂ) * F (m : ℕ)), ← Finset.sum_mul]
    have hdiv : ∑ q ∈ (m : ℕ).divisorsAntidiagonal, (moebius q.1 : ℂ)
        = ∑ d ∈ (m : ℕ).divisors, (moebius d : ℂ) :=
      Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal (fun a _ => (moebius a : ℂ))
    rw [hdiv, sum_divisors_moebius_eq (m : ℕ)]
    by_cases hm1 : (m : ℕ) = 1
    · rw [if_pos hm1, if_pos hm1, one_mul]
    · rw [if_neg hm1, if_neg hm1, zero_mul]
  have hone : (∑' m : ℕ+, (if (m : ℕ) = 1 then F (m : ℕ) else 0)) = F 1 := by
    have hsingle : ∀ m : ℕ+, (if (m : ℕ) = 1 then F (m : ℕ) else 0)
        = if m = 1 then F 1 else 0 := by
      intro m
      by_cases hm : m = 1
      · subst hm
        simp
      · have hm' : (m : ℕ) ≠ 1 := fun h => hm (PNat.coe_injective (by simpa using h))
        rw [if_neg hm', if_neg hm]
    rw [tsum_congr hsingle, tsum_ite_eq]
  rw [hpull, hsigma, tsum_congr hinner, hone]

source_arguments.name: RHTower.visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum_eq_add
source_arguments.statement:
theorem visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum_eq_add
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum x y =
      mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (x + y)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum_eq_add
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum x y =
      mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (x + y)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let F : ℕ → ℂ := fun n =>
    visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum ((n : ℝ) * x) ((n : ℝ) * y)
  have hpair : Summable (fun c : ℕ+ × ℕ+ =>
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (c.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
        F ((c.1 : ℕ) * (c.2 : ℕ))) := by
    apply (summable_moebius_visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum_pair x y hx hy).congr
    intro c
    dsimp [F]
  have hcollapse :
      (∑' c : ℕ+ × ℕ+,
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (c.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          F ((c.1 : ℕ) * (c.2 : ℕ))) = F 1 :=
    tsum_moebius_pair hpair
  have hrows : ∀ n : ℕ+,
      (∑' m : ℕ+, F ((n : ℕ) * (m : ℕ))) =
        Complex.exp (-((n : ℝ) * (x + y))) := by
    intro n
    have hnx : 0 < (n : ℝ) * x := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast n.property) hx
    have hny : 0 < (n : ℝ) * y := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast n.property) hy
    have h := tsum_visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum_dilate
      ((n : ℝ) * x) ((n : ℝ) * y) hnx hny
    calc
      (∑' m : ℕ+, F ((n : ℕ) * (m : ℕ))) =
          ∑' m : ℕ+, visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum
            ((m : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * x)) ((m : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * y)) := by
        apply tsum_congr
        intro m
        dsimp [F]
        apply congrArg₂ visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum
        · push_cast
          ring
        · push_cast
          ring
      _ = Complex.exp (-((↑((n : ℝ) * x) : ℂ) + ↑((n : ℝ) * y))) := h
      _ = Complex.exp (-((n : ℝ) * (x + y))) := by
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
  have hseries :
      (∑' c : ℕ+ × ℕ+,
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (c.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          F ((c.1 : ℕ) * (c.2 : ℕ))) =
        ∑' n : ℕ+, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-((n : ℝ) * (x + y))) := by
    rw [hpair.tsum_prod]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    change (∑' m : ℕ+, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n : ℕ) : ℂ) *
      F ((n : ℕ) * (m : ℕ))) =
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-((n : ℝ) * (x + y)))
    rw [tsum_mul_left, hrows n]
  have hphi :
      (∑' n : ℕ+, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-((n : ℝ) * (x + y)))) =
        mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (x + y) := by
    have hrow := mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform_eq_tsum_lambertRow
      (x + y) (add_pos hx hy) 1
    rw [show ((1 : ℕ+) : ℝ) * (x + y) = x + y by norm_num] at hrow
    calc
      (∑' n : ℕ+, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-((n : ℝ) * (x + y)))) =
          ∑' n : ℕ+, mobiusLaplaceLambertPair (x + y) (1, n) := by
        apply tsum_congr
        intro n
        rw [mobiusLaplaceLambertPair]
        norm_num
      _ = mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (x + y) := hrow.symm
  have hF : F 1 = visibleCoprimeMobiusLaplaceSum x y := by
    dsimp [F]
    norm_num
  rw [hseries, hphi] at hcollapse
  exact hF.symm.trans hcollapse.symm

source_arguments.name: RHTower.norm_mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform_dilate_le
source_arguments.statement:
theorem norm_mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform_dilate_le
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ+) :
    ‖mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform ((k : ℝ) * x)‖ ≤
      mobiusLaplaceDilationConstant x * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * x))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem norm_mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform_dilate_le
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ+) :
    ‖mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform ((k : ℝ) * x)‖ ≤
      mobiusLaplaceDilationConstant x * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * x))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hgeoNat : Summable (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * x))) := by
    simpa using summable_pow_mul_exp_neg 0 hx
  have hgeo : Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * x))) :=
    hgeoNat.comp_injective PNat.coe_injective
  have hrow : Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => mobiusLaplaceLambertPair x (k, n)) :=
    (summable_mobiusLaplaceLambertPair hx).comp_injective
      (fun _ _ h => Prod.mk.inj h |>.2)
  have hmajor : Summable (fun n : ℕ+ =>
      (Real.exp x * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * x))) *
        Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * x))) :=
    hgeo.mul_left _
  rw [mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform_eq_tsum_lambertRow x hx k]
  calc
    ‖∑' n : ℕ+, mobiusLaplaceLambertPair x (k, n)‖ ≤
        ∑' n : ℕ+, ‖mobiusLaplaceLambertPair x (k, n)‖ :=
      norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hrow.norm
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ+, (Real.exp x * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * x))) *
          Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * x)) := by
      refine hrow.norm.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => ?_) hmajor
      rw [mobiusLaplaceLambertPair, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
      simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
      have hmu : ‖((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_intCast]
        exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := n)
      have hk : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast k.property
      have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast n.property
      have hprod : (k : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) - 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hk) (sub_nonneg.mpr hn)]
      have hexp : Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) * x)) ≤
          (Real.exp x * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * x))) *
            Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) * x)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        nlinarith
      calc
        ‖((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℂ)‖ *
              Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) * x)) ≤
            1 * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) * x)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmu (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ ≤ _ := by simpa using hexp
    _ = mobiusLaplaceDilationConstant x * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * x)) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left]
      unfold mobiusLaplaceDilationConstant
      ring

        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius x.1 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          primeFreeDivisorIncrement x.2) =
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) *
          primeFreeDivisorIncrementAF) n := by
    rw [mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    have hx2 : x.2 ≠ 0 := by
      apply right_ne_zero_of_mul
      rw [(Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mp hx).1]

    rw [primeFreeDivisorIncrementAF_apply hx2]
    rfl

    moebius_mul_primeFreeDivisorIncrementAF
  rw [hlhs, hconv]
  change ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n -
      (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) n +
      (algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
        (2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)) n = _
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.natCoe_apply,
    ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply_ne hn]
  rw [completedPrimePolarGammaAtom]
  by_cases hn1 : n = 1
  · subst n
    simp [ArithmeticFunction.algebraMap_apply_one]
  · rw [if_neg hn1]
    have hAlg : (algebraMap ℝ (ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
        (2 * Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)) n = 0 := by
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
        ArithmeticFunction.smul_map, ArithmeticFunction.one_apply,
        if_neg hn1, smul_zero]
    rw [hAlg]
    ring

    ∃ alpha z : ℂ, alpha ≠ 0 ∧ IsAlgebraic ℚ alpha ∧
      (∀ q : ℚ, z ≠ q • alpha) ∧
      IsAlgebraic (relativeExponentialBase alpha) z ∧
      IsAlgebraic (relativeExponentialBase alpha) (Complex.exp z)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hfail, hexists⟩
    exact exists_relativeExponentialBase_edge_of_nonzero_additive_character
      x hx hfail hexists
  · rintro ⟨alpha, z, halpha0, halpha, hznot, hz, hexpz⟩
    let x : Fin 2 → ℂ := ![alpha, z]
    have hx : LinearIndependent ℚ x := by
      simpa [x] using
        linearIndependent_fin_two_of_ne_zero_of_not_rat_smul alpha z halpha0 hznot
    have hfailNorm : ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧
        (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.range (![alpha, z] : Fin 2 → ℂ) ∪
          Set.range (fun j : Fin 2 => Complex.exp ((![alpha, z] : Fin 2 → ℂ) j))) ∧
        AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t :=
      (relativeExponentialBase_edge_iff_no_affine_stageTwo_extraction
        alpha z halpha0 halpha).mp ⟨hz, hexpz⟩
    have hfail : ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧
        (∀ i, t i ∈ exponentialPairGeneratorSet x) ∧ AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t := by
      simpa [x, exponentialPairGeneratorSet] using hfailNorm
    let m : Fin 2 → ℤ := ![1, 0]
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm
      have h0 := congrFun hm 0
      norm_num [m] at h0
    have hm : m ∈ additiveAlgebraicCharacterLattice x := by
      change IsAlgebraic ℚ (∑ i, m i • x i)
      simpa [m, x, Fin.sum_univ_two] using halpha
    exact ⟨x, hx, hfail, m, hm0, hm⟩

source_arguments.statement:
theorem exists_periodRelativeBase_edge_of_nonzero_multiplicative_character
    (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) (hx : LinearIndependent ℚ x)
    (hfail : ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧
      (∀ i, t i ∈ exponentialPairGeneratorSet x) ∧ AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t)
    (hexists : ∃ m : Fin 2 → ℤ,
      m ≠ 0 ∧ m ∈ multiplicativeAlgebraicCharacterLattice x) :
    ∃ alpha z : ℂ, alpha ≠ 0 ∧ IsAlgebraic ℚ (Complex.exp alpha) ∧
      (∀ q : ℚ, z ≠ q • alpha) ∧
      IsAlgebraic (periodRelativeBase alpha) z ∧
      IsAlgebraic (periodRelativeBase alpha) (Complex.exp z)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem exists_periodRelativeBase_edge_of_nonzero_multiplicative_character
    (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) (hx : LinearIndependent ℚ x)
    (hfail : ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧
      (∀ i, t i ∈ exponentialPairGeneratorSet x) ∧ AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t)
    (hexists : ∃ m : Fin 2 → ℤ,
      m ≠ 0 ∧ m ∈ multiplicativeAlgebraicCharacterLattice x) :
    ∃ alpha z : ℂ, alpha ≠ 0 ∧ IsAlgebraic ℚ (Complex.exp alpha) ∧
      (∀ q : ℚ, z ≠ q • alpha) ∧
      IsAlgebraic (periodRelativeBase alpha) z ∧
      IsAlgebraic (periodRelativeBase alpha) (Complex.exp z)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := hexists
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hprimitive⟩ :=
    exists_primitive_multiplicativeAlgebraicCharacter x m hm hm0
  let M := primitiveIntegralIsogenyMatrix2 (p 0) (p 1) hprimitive
  let x' := integralIsogenyAdditiveCoordinates x M
  have hx' : LinearIndependent ℚ x' := by
    change LinearIndependent ℚ (fun i : Fin 2 ↦
      if i = 0 then (M.a : ℂ) * x 0 + (M.b : ℂ) * x 1
      else (M.c : ℂ) * x 0 + (M.d : ℂ) * x 1)
    exact linearIndependent_integral_isogeny_fin_two x hx M.a M.b M.c M.d M.det_ne
  have hfail' : ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧
      (∀ i, t i ∈ exponentialPairGeneratorSet x') ∧ AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t := by
    simpa [x'] using no_fin_two_extraction_integralIsogeny x hx hfail M
  let alpha := x' 0
  let z := x' 1
  have hexpalpha : IsAlgebraic ℚ (Complex.exp alpha) := by
    change IsAlgebraic ℚ (Complex.exp (∑ i, p i • x i)) at hp
    simpa [alpha, x', M, primitiveIntegralIsogenyMatrix2,
      integralIsogenyAdditiveCoordinates, Fin.sum_univ_two, zsmul_eq_mul] using hp
  have halpha0 : alpha ≠ 0 := hx'.ne_zero 0
  have hznot : ∀ q : ℚ, z ≠ q • alpha :=
    not_rat_smul_second_of_linearIndependent_fin_two x' hx'
  have hx'vec : x' = ![alpha, z] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hfailNorm : ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧
      (∀ i, t i ∈ Set.range (![alpha, z] : Fin 2 → ℂ) ∪
        Set.range (fun j : Fin 2 => Complex.exp ((![alpha, z] : Fin 2 → ℂ) j))) ∧
      AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t := by
    rw [← hx'vec]
    simpa [exponentialPairGeneratorSet] using hfail'
  have hedge :=
    (periodRelativeBase_edge_iff_no_period_stageTwo_extraction
      alpha z halpha0 hexpalpha).mpr hfailNorm
  exact ⟨alpha, z, halpha0, hexpalpha, hznot, hedge.1, hedge.2⟩

/-- Exact classification of the nonzero multiplicative-character branch of stage-two failure. -/

method.description: The proof constructs a linearly independent pair (alpha, z) from an algebraic character lattice and uses injectivity and algebraic independence to establish period properties.
assumptions: ¬ ∃ t : Fin 2 → ℂ, Function.Injective t ∧ (∀ i, t i ∈ exponentialPairGeneratorSet x) ∧ AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t
∃ m : Fin 2 → ℤ, m ≠ 0 ∧ m ∈ multiplicativeAlgebraicCharacterLattice x

obligations: transfer to existence of non-periodic exponential

source_arguments.name: RHTower.evenMoment_symmetric_sinc
source_arguments.statement:
theorem evenMoment_symmetric_sinc
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in (-T)..T, ‖dpoly a s t‖ ^ (2 * k)) / (2 * T) =
      (∑ m ∈ powSupport s k, (powConv a s k m) ^ 2) +
        ∑ m ∈ powSupport s k, ∑ n ∈ (powSupport s k).erase m,
          powConv a s k m * powConv a s k n *
            Real.sinc ((Real.log n - Real.log m) * T)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem evenMoment_symmetric_sinc
    (a : ℕ → ℝ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in (-T)..T, ‖dpoly a s t‖ ^ (2 * k)) / (2 * T) =
      (∑ m ∈ powSupport s k, (powConv a s k m) ^ 2) +
        ∑ m ∈ powSupport s k, ∑ n ∈ (powSupport s k).erase m,
          powConv a s k m * powConv a s k n *
            Real.sinc ((Real.log n - Real.log m) * T)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hrw : ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖dpoly a s t‖ ^ (2 * k) =
        ‖dpoly (powConv a s k) (powSupport s k) t‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [show 2 * k = k * 2 by ring, pow_mul, ← norm_pow, dpoly_pow a s hs t k]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t _ => hrw t)]
  exact secondMoment_symmetric_sinc (powConv a s k) (powSupport s k) T hT

source_arguments.name: triv_bound_zeta
source_arguments.statement:
theorem triv_bound_zeta :  ∃C ≥ 0, ∀(σ₀ t : ℝ), 1 < σ₀ →
    ‖- ζ' (σ₀ + t * I) / ζ (σ₀ + t * I)‖ ≤ (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹ + C
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem triv_bound_zeta :  ∃C ≥ 0, ∀(σ₀ t : ℝ), 1 < σ₀ →
    ‖- ζ' (σ₀ + t * I) / ζ (σ₀ + t * I)‖ ≤ (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹ + C
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let ⟨U, ⟨U_in_nhds, zeta_residue_on_U⟩⟩ := riemannZetaLogDerivResidue
  let ⟨open_in_U, ⟨open_in_U_subs_U, open_in_U_is_open, one_in_open_U⟩⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_iff.mp U_in_nhds
  let ⟨ε₀, ⟨ε_pos, metric_ball_around_1_is_in_U'⟩⟩ :=
    EMetric.isOpen_iff.mp open_in_U_is_open (1 : ℂ) one_in_open_U

  let ε := if ε₀ = ⊤ then ENNReal.ofReal 1 else ε₀
  have O1 : ε ≠ ⊤ := by
    unfold ε
    by_cases h : ε₀ = ⊤ <;> simp [*]

  have metric_ball_around_1_is_in_U :
    Metric.eball (1 : ℂ) ε ⊆ U := by
      unfold ε
      by_cases h : ε₀ = ⊤
      · simp only [↓reduceIte, ENNReal.ofReal_one, h]
        have T : Metric.eball (1 : ℂ) 1 ⊆ Metric.eball 1 ε₀ := by
          simp [*]
        exact subset_trans (subset_trans T metric_ball_around_1_is_in_U') open_in_U_subs_U

      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
        exact subset_trans metric_ball_around_1_is_in_U' open_in_U_subs_U

  have O2 : ε ≠ 0 := by
    unfold ε
    by_cases h : ε₀ = ⊤
    · simp [*]
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, ne_eq, h]
      exact pos_iff_ne_zero.mp ε_pos

  let metric_ball_around_1 := Metric.eball (1 : ℂ) ε
  let ε_div_two := ε / 2
  let boundary := ENNReal.toReal (1 + ε_div_two)

  let ⟨bound, ⟨bound_pos, bound_prop⟩⟩ :=
      BddAbove.exists_ge zeta_residue_on_U 0

  have boundary_geq_one : 1 < boundary := by
      unfold boundary
      have Z : (1 : ENNReal).toReal = 1 := by rfl
      rw [←Z]
      have U : ε_div_two ≠ ⊤ := by
        refine ENNReal.div_ne_top O1 ?_
        simp
      simp only [ENNReal.toReal_one, ne_eq, ENNReal.one_ne_top, not_false_eq_true,
        ENNReal.toReal_add _ U, lt_add_iff_pos_right, gt_iff_lt]
      refine ENNReal.toReal_pos ?_ ?_
      · unfold ε_div_two
        simp [*]
      · exact U

  let const : ℝ := bound
  let final_const : ℝ := (boundary - 1)⁻¹ + const
  have final_const_pos : final_const ≥ 0 := by bound
  have const_le_final_const : const ≤ final_const := by bound

  /- final const is actually the constant that we will use -/

  refine ⟨final_const, final_const_pos, fun σ₀ t σ₀_gt ↦ ?_⟩
  have U4 : ENNReal.ofReal 1 ≠ ⊤ := by exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have Z0 : ε_div_two.toReal < ε.toReal := by
    exact ENNReal.toReal_strict_mono O1 <| ENNReal.half_lt_self O2 O1

  -- Pick a neighborhood, if in neighborhood then we are good
  -- If outside of the neighborhood then use that ζ' / ζ is monotonic
  -- and take the bound to be the edge but this will require some more work

  by_cases! h : σ₀ ≤ boundary
  · have σ₀_in_ball : (↑σ₀ : ℂ) ∈ metric_ball_around_1 := by
      unfold metric_ball_around_1
      unfold Metric.eball
      simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [edist_dist, dist_eq_norm]
      norm_cast
      have U : 0 ≤ σ₀ - 1 := by linarith
      simp only [Real.norm_of_nonneg U, gt_iff_lt]
      simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal U O1]
      calc
        _ ≤ boundary - 1 := by linarith
        _ = ENNReal.toReal (1 + ε_div_two) - 1 := rfl
        _ = ENNReal.toReal (1 + ε_div_two) - ENNReal.toReal (ENNReal.ofReal 1) := by simp
        _ ≤ ENNReal.toReal (1 + ε_div_two - ENNReal.ofReal 1) := ENNReal.le_toReal_sub U4
        _ = ENNReal.toReal (ε_div_two) := by
          simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_one, ENNReal.addLECancellable_iff_ne, ne_eq,
            ENNReal.one_ne_top, not_false_eq_true, AddLECancellable.add_tsub_cancel_left]
        _ < ε.toReal := Z0

    have σ₀_in_U : (↑σ₀ : ℂ) ∈ (U \ {1}) := by
      refine Set.mem_sdiff_singleton.mpr ?_
      constructor
      · exact metric_ball_around_1_is_in_U σ₀_in_ball
      · by_contra a
        have U : σ₀ = 1 := by exact ofReal_eq_one.mp a
        rw [U] at σ₀_gt
        linarith

    have bdd := Set.forall_mem_image.mp bound_prop (σ₀_in_U)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.div_apply] at bdd

    calc
      _ ≤ ‖ζ' σ₀ / ζ σ₀‖ := by
        exact dlog_riemannZeta_bdd_on_vertical_lines_generalized σ₀ σ₀ t (σ₀_gt) (by simp)
      _ = ‖- ζ' σ₀ / ζ σ₀‖ := by simp only [Complex.norm_div, norm_neg]
      _ = ‖(- ζ' σ₀ / ζ σ₀ - (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹) + (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹‖ := by
        simp only [Complex.norm_div, norm_neg, ofReal_inv, ofReal_sub, ofReal_one, sub_add_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖(- ζ' σ₀ / ζ σ₀ - (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹)‖ + ‖(σ₀ - 1)⁻¹‖ := by
        have Z := norm_add_le (- ζ' σ₀ / ζ σ₀ - (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹) ((σ₀ - 1)⁻¹)
        norm_cast at Z
      _ ≤ const + ‖(σ₀ - 1)⁻¹‖ := by
        have U := add_le_add_left bdd ‖(σ₀ - 1)⁻¹‖
        ring_nf at U
        ring_nf
        norm_cast at U
        norm_cast
      _ ≤ const + (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹ := by
        simp [norm_inv]
        have pos : 0 ≤ σ₀ - 1 := by
          linarith
        simp [abs_of_nonneg pos]
      _ = (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹ + const := by
        rw [add_comm]
      _ ≤ (σ₀ - 1)⁻¹ + final_const := by
        simp [const_le_final_const]

  · have boundary_in_ball : (↑boundary : ℂ) ∈ metric_ball_around_1 := by
      unfold metric_ball_around_1
      unfold Metric.eball
      simp only [mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [edist_dist, dist_eq_norm]
      norm_cast
      have U : 0 ≤ boundary - 1 := by linarith

source_arguments.name: Quantum.StabilizerGroup.RotatedSurfaceCodeN.toSymplectic_xStab_X
source_arguments.statement:
private lemma toSymplectic_xStab_X (xf : RotatedSurface.XFaceIdx L)
    (q : Fin (numQubits L)) :
    NQubitPauliOperator.toSymplectic (xStab L xf).operators
        (Fin.castAdd (numQubits L) q) =
      (if vtxOfQubit L q ∈ RotatedSurface.xSupport xf then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0)
source_arguments.source_statement:
private lemma toSymplectic_xStab_X (xf : RotatedSurface.XFaceIdx L)
    (q : Fin (numQubits L)) :
    NQubitPauliOperator.toSymplectic (xStab L xf).operators
        (Fin.castAdd (numQubits L) q) =
      (if vtxOfQubit L q ∈ RotatedSurface.xSupport xf then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  rw [NQubitPauliOperator.toSymplectic_X_part]
  set c : RotatedSurface.VtxIdx L → ZMod 2 :=
    (RotatedSurface.rotatedSurfaceHomologicalCode L).boundary2
      ((RotatedSurface.rotatedSurfaceHomologicalCode L).singleFace xf) with hc
  have hc_val : c (vtxOfQubit L q) =
      (if vtxOfQubit L q ∈ RotatedSurface.xSupport xf then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0) := by
    rw [hc]; exact boundary2_singleFace_apply L xf (vtxOfQubit L q)
  change ((xStab L xf).operators q).toSymplecticSingle.1 = _
  rw [show (xStab L xf).operators q =
      if ∃ v : RotatedSurface.VtxIdx L,
        RotatedSurface.rscQubitEquiv L v = q ∧ c v = 1
      then PauliOperator.X else PauliOperator.I from rfl]
  by_cases h1 : c (vtxOfQubit L q) = 1
  · have hex : ∃ v : RotatedSurface.VtxIdx L,
        RotatedSurface.rscQubitEquiv L v = q ∧ c v = 1 :=
      ⟨vtxOfQubit L q, rscQubitEquiv_vtxOfQubit L q, h1⟩
    rw [if_pos hex]
    have : (if vtxOfQubit L q ∈ RotatedSurface.xSupport xf then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0) = 1 := by
      rw [hc_val] at h1; exact h1
    rw [this]; rfl
  · have hnotex : ¬ ∃ v : RotatedSurface.VtxIdx L,
        RotatedSurface.rscQubitEquiv L v = q ∧ c v = 1 := by
      rintro ⟨v, hv, hcv⟩
      have hveq : v = vtxOfQubit L q := by
        apply (RotatedSurface.rscQubitEquiv L).injective
        rw [rscQubitEquiv_vtxOfQubit, hv]
      rw [hveq] at hcv
      exact h1 hcv
    rw [if_neg hnotex]
    have h0 : c (vtxOfQubit L q) = 0 := by
      rw [hc_val] at h1 ⊢
      by_cases h : vtxOfQubit L q ∈ RotatedSurface.xSupport xf
      · rw [if_pos h] at h1; exact absurd rfl h1
      · rw [if_neg h]
    have : (if vtxOfQubit L q ∈ RotatedSurface.xSupport xf then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0) = 0 := by
      rw [hc_val] at h0; exact h0
    rw [this]; rfl
