theorem gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
    {n D τ : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) ℂ}
    {anchor : Fin (n + 2) →₀ ℕ}
    (haMax : ∀ m ∈ Q.support,
      jetMonomialDegree n m = D →
        magnitudeShiftCode n Q m ≤ magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor)
    {T : ℤ} {R : ℕ} {a : ℤ →₀ ℕ}
    (haFace : a ∈ gaussianOffsetFace D T R)
    (hpoly : polynomialPatternWeightPoly n D R τ Q
      (gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
        (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R) ≠ 0) :
    (((τ + magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ)) ≤ T
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
    {n D τ : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) ℂ}
    {anchor : Fin (n + 2) →₀ ℕ}
    (haMax : ∀ m ∈ Q.support,
      jetMonomialDegree n m = D →
        magnitudeShiftCode n Q m ≤ magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor)
    {T : ℤ} {R : ℕ} {a : ℤ →₀ ℕ}
    (haFace : a ∈ gaussianOffsetFace D T R)
    (hpoly : polynomialPatternWeightPoly n D R τ Q
      (gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
        (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R) ≠ 0) :
    (((τ + magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ)) ≤ T
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let p := gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
    (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R
  have hpcount : (∑ r, (p r : ℕ)) = D := by
    simpa only [p] using gaussianOffsetPatternWindow_count haFace
  have hpSurvivor : p ∈ polynomialPatternSurvivors n D R τ Q (2 * R + 1) := by
    rw [polynomialPatternSurvivors, degreeDPolynomialPatterns,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨⟨Finset.mem_univ p, hpcount⟩, by simpa only [p] using hpoly⟩
  have hfloor := polynomialPattern_source_floor_of_survivor
    haMax hpSurvivor
  have hfloorInt :
      (D : ℤ) * (R : ℤ) + (τ : ℤ) +
          (magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℤ) ≤
        (polynomialPatternSourceSum p : ℤ) +
          (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfloor
  have hsource :
      (polynomialPatternSourceSum p : ℤ) - (R : ℤ) * (D : ℤ) = T := by
    simpa only [p] using gaussianOffsetPatternWindow_source haFace
  push_cast
  rw [← hsource]
  nlinarith [hfloorInt]

    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (c : I → Nat.Primes → ℂ) (M : I → ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i p, ‖c i p‖ ≤ M i) (a : ℂ)
    (htail : TailCoefficientIndependent c) :

      (fun i => analyticPrimeObservableShiftCarrier (c i) (M i) (hM i) a)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem analyticPrimeObservableShiftCarrier_algebraicIndependent_over_eulerBase
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (c : I → Nat.Primes → ℂ) (M : I → ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i p, ‖c i p‖ ≤ M i) (a : ℂ)
    (htail : TailCoefficientIndependent c) :
    AlgebraicIndependent (analyticEulerExponentialBase a)
      (fun i => analyticPrimeObservableShiftCarrier (c i) (M i) (hM i) a)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let f : I → finiteAbscissaArithmeticSubalgebra := fun i =>
    finiteAbscissaDirichletShift a
      (uniformlyBoundedPrimeFiniteAbscissa (c i) (M i) (hM i))
  let d : I → Nat.Primes → ℂ := fun i p =>
    c i p * primeShiftFactor a p
  have hf : ∀ i, (f i).1 = arithmeticOfPrimeColumn (d i) := by
    intro i
    simpa only [f, d, Function.iterate_zero_apply, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      (analyticPrimeObservableShiftJetSource_eq_arithmeticOfPrimeColumn
        (c i) (M i) (hM i) a 0)
  have hdtail : TailCoefficientIndependent d := by
    have hweighted :=
      (tailCoefficientIndependent_commonWeight_iff c
        (primeShiftFactor a) (primeShiftFactor_ne_zero a)).mpr htail
    simpa only [d, mul_comm] using hweighted
  have hsource :=
    algebraicIndependent_finiteAbscissaPrimeColumns_over_pulledFinitePrime
      f d hf hdtail
  have hpulled :=
    algebraicIndependent_finiteAbscissaLSeries_over_pulledFinitePrimeCoordinate
      f hsource
  have heuler : AlgebraicIndependent (analyticEulerExponentialBase a)
      (fun i => finiteAbscissaLSeriesToUpperEndMero (f i)) :=
    (@AlgebraicIndependent.restrictScalars
      I (analyticEulerExponentialBase a) upperEndMeroField
      (fun i => finiteAbscissaLSeriesToUpperEndMero (f i))
      _ _ _ analyticPulledFinitePrimeCoordinateField _
      (analyticEulerBasePulledFinitePrimeCoordinateAlgebra a)
      _ (analyticEulerBasePulledFinitePrimeCoordinateUpperEndScalarTower a)
      (analyticEulerBaseToPulledFinitePrimeCoordinate_injective a) hpulled)
  simpa only [f, analyticPrimeObservableShiftCarrier] using heuler

    (K : RouteERecurrenceKernel ι) (hrow : ∀ i, K.rowMass i = 1) :

      4 * K.columnLoadDirichletEnergy
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  unfold RouteEWeightedGibbsGraph.inverseDegreeDirichletEnergy columnLoadDirichletEnergy
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro p _hp
  rw [K.inverseDegree_eq_twoSidedInverseLoad hrow,
    K.inverseDegree_eq_twoSidedInverseLoad hrow]
  have hweight :
      0 ≤ K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.base p.1 p.2 * K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.weight p.2 :=
    mul_nonneg (K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.base_nonneg p.1 p.2)
      (K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.weight_nonneg p.2)
  calc
    K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.base p.1 p.2 * K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.weight p.2 *
        (routeETwoSidedInverseLoad (K.columnLoad p.1) -
          routeETwoSidedInverseLoad (K.columnLoad p.2)) ^ 2 ≤
        K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.base p.1 p.2 * K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.weight p.2 *
          (4 * (K.columnLoad p.1 - K.columnLoad p.2) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (routeETwoSidedInverseLoad_sub_sq_le _ _
          (K.columnLoad_nonneg p.1) (K.columnLoad_nonneg p.2)) hweight
    _ = 4 * (K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.base p.1 p.2 *
          K.toWeightedGibbsGraph.weight p.2 *
            (K.columnLoad p.1 - K.columnLoad p.2) ^ 2) := by ring

by
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, (↗χ * ↗μ) n * (n : ℂ) ^ (-s) = LSeries.term (↗χ * ↗μ) s n := by
    intro n
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn

  have hsum : ∑' n : ℕ, (↗χ * ↗μ) n * (n : ℂ) ^ (-s) = LSeries (↗χ * ↗μ) s := by

  have hone := DirichletCharacter.LSeries.mul_mu_eq_one χ hs

    DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries χ hs
  have hne : LSeries ↗χ s ≠ 0 := DirichletCharacter.LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re χ hs
  rw [hL]
  field_simp

theorem summable_smoothAFE_direct {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {s : ℂ} {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)

  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := exists_norm_smoothAFECutoff_le_neg_rpow hA

theorem summable_translatedGeneralizedCoefficient
    {mu : ℕ → ℝ} (hmu : StrictMono mu) (hmu0 : 0 < mu 0)
    {a : ℕ → ℂ} {sigma : ℝ}
    (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖ * Real.exp (-mu n * sigma))
    (P : AddMonoidAlgebra ℂ ℂ) :

      Real.exp (-mu n * finiteTranslationThreshold P sigma))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem summable_translatedGeneralizedCoefficient
    {mu : ℕ → ℝ} (hmu : StrictMono mu) (hmu0 : 0 < mu 0)
    {a : ℕ → ℂ} {sigma : ℝ}
    (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖ * Real.exp (-mu n * sigma))
    (P : AddMonoidAlgebra ℂ ℂ) :
    Summable (fun n => ‖translatedGeneralizedCoefficient P mu a n‖ *
      Real.exp (-mu n * finiteTranslationThreshold P sigma))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hmu_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < mu n :=
    hmu0.trans_le (hmu.monotone (Nat.zero_le n))
  have hshift (h : ℂ) (hh : h ∈ P.coeff.support) :
      Summable (fun n => P.coeff h * (a n * Complex.exp (-(mu n : ℂ) *
        ((finiteTranslationThreshold P sigma : ℂ) + h)))) := by
    apply Summable.mul_left
    exact summable_generalizedDirichletTerm_of_re_ge hmu_pos ha
      (finiteTranslationThreshold_le_re_add P sigma _ le_rfl hh)
  have hsum : Summable (fun n => ∑ h ∈ P.coeff.support, P.coeff h *
      (a n * Complex.exp (-(mu n : ℂ) *
        ((finiteTranslationThreshold P sigma : ℂ) + h)))) :=
    summable_sum fun h hh => hshift h hh
  have hweighted : Summable (fun n => translatedGeneralizedCoefficient P mu a n *
      Complex.exp (-(mu n : ℂ) * (finiteTranslationThreshold P sigma : ℂ))) :=
    hsum.congr fun n =>
      (translatedCoefficient_weighted_eq_sum P mu a
        (finiteTranslationThreshold P sigma) n).symm
  simpa [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp] using hweighted.norm

by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hz⟩ := RHTower.exists_Xi_zero_gt (max T 0)
  let s : ℂ := 1 / 2 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hs : s ∈ minimumStrip := by norm_num [s, minimumStrip]
  have him : s.im = t := by simp [s]
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [him]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) ht
  · rw [him]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) ht
  · have hd := unitPhaseStrip_denominators hs
    have hxi : RHTower.xi s = 0 := by
      change RHTower.XiC (t : ℂ) = 0
      rw [RHTower.XiC_ofReal, hz, Complex.ofReal_zero]
    rw [RHTower.xi_eq_archFactor_mul_zeta hd.1 hd.2.1
      (Complex.Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hs.1)] at hxi
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hxi).resolve_left (RHTower.archFactor_ne_zero_strip hs)

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  intro z
  rw [spectralDifferenceMeasure,
    spectralDifferenceMeasure,
    Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) (measurableSet_singleton z),
    Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) (measurableSet_singleton z),
    Measure.prod_apply (by measurability),
    Measure.prod_apply (by measurability)]
  let S : Set ℝ := {x | mu {x - z} ≠ 0}
  have hScount : S.Countable := by
    let A : Set ℝ := {y | mu {y} ≠ 0}
    have hA : A.Countable := countable_atoms mu
    have hsub : S ⊆ (fun y => y + z) '' A := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨x - z, hx, by ring⟩
    exact (hA.image (fun y => y + z)).mono hsub
  have hfiber (x : ℝ) :
      Prod.mk x ⁻¹' (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 - p.2) ⁻¹' {z} =
        {x - z} := by
    ext y
    simp
    constructor <;> intro hy <;> linarith
  simp_rw [hfiber]
  have hsupp :
      Function.support (fun x => mu {x - z}) ⊆ S := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx
  have hsupp' :
      Function.support (fun x => nu {x - z}) ⊆ S := by
    intro x hx
    have : mu {x - z} ≠ 0 := by
      rw [h (x - z)]
      exact hx
    exact this
  rw [← setLIntegral_eq_of_support_subset (μ := mu) hsupp,
    ← setLIntegral_eq_of_support_subset (μ := nu) hsupp',
    lintegral_countable _ hScount,
    lintegral_countable _ hScount]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro x
  rw [h x, h (x.1 - z)]

source_arguments.statement:
theorem gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
    {n D τ : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) ℂ}
    {anchor : Fin (n + 2) →₀ ℕ}
    (haMax : ∀ m ∈ Q.support,
      jetMonomialDegree n m = D →
        magnitudeShiftCode n Q m ≤ magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor)
    {T : ℤ} {R : ℕ} {a : ℤ →₀ ℕ}
    (haFace : a ∈ gaussianOffsetFace D T R)
    (hpoly : polynomialPatternWeightPoly n D R τ Q
      (gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
        (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R) ≠ 0) :
    (((τ + magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ)) ≤ T
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem gaussianOffsetSource_floor_of_weightPoly_ne_zero
    {n D τ : ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) ℂ}
    {anchor : Fin (n + 2) →₀ ℕ}
    (haMax : ∀ m ∈ Q.support,
      jetMonomialDegree n m = D →
        magnitudeShiftCode n Q m ≤ magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor)
    {T : ℤ} {R : ℕ} {a : ℤ →₀ ℕ}
    (haFace : a ∈ gaussianOffsetFace D T R)
    (hpoly : polynomialPatternWeightPoly n D R τ Q
      (gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
        (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R) ≠ 0) :
    (((τ + magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ)) ≤ T
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let p := gaussianOffsetPatternWindow a
    (gaussianOffsetFace_totalCount haFace) R
  have hpcount : (∑ r, (p r : ℕ)) = D := by
    simpa only [p] using gaussianOffsetPatternWindow_count haFace
  have hpSurvivor : p ∈ polynomialPatternSurvivors n D R τ Q (2 * R + 1) := by
    rw [polynomialPatternSurvivors, degreeDPolynomialPatterns,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨⟨Finset.mem_univ p, hpcount⟩, by simpa only [p] using hpoly⟩
  have hfloor := polynomialPattern_source_floor_of_survivor
    haMax hpSurvivor
  have hfloorInt :
      (D : ℤ) * (R : ℤ) + (τ : ℤ) +
          (magnitudeMaxJetOrder n Q : ℤ) ≤
        (polynomialPatternSourceSum p : ℤ) +
          (magnitudeShiftCode n Q anchor : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfloor
  have hsource :
      (polynomialPatternSourceSum p : ℤ) - (R : ℤ) * (D : ℤ) = T := by
    simpa only [p] using gaussianOffsetPatternWindow_source haFace
  push_cast
  rw [← hsource]
  nlinarith [hfloorInt]

source_arguments.statement:
theorem eventually_fidelityReturnTime_le (E p : Fin (e + 3) → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1) (hpnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hg0 : 0 < E 1 - E 0)
    (hnv : ¬ KleinbockMargulis.VWA (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ)))
    (t₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ δ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      (fidelityReturnSet E p t₀ δ).Nonempty ∧
        fidelityReturnTime E p t₀ δ
          ≤ 2 * π * ((firstHit (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ))
              (1 / (4 * π) * Real.sqrt δ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (E 1 - E 0)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem eventually_fidelityReturnTime_le (E p : Fin (e + 3) → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1) (hpnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ p j) (hg0 : 0 < E 1 - E 0)
    (hnv : ¬ KleinbockMargulis.VWA (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ)))
    (t₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ δ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      (fidelityReturnSet E p t₀ δ).Nonempty ∧
        fidelityReturnTime E p t₀ δ
          ≤ 2 * π * ((firstHit (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ))
              (1 / (4 * π) * Real.sqrt δ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (E 1 - E 0)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hpi : (0 : ℝ) < π := Real.pi_pos
  have hsq := tendsto_const_mul_sqrt_nhdsGT (a := 1 / (4 * π)) (by positivity)
  have hbig : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ =>
      (firstHit (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ))
        (1 / (4 * π) * Real.sqrt δ) : ℕ)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) atTop :=
    (tendsto_firstHit_atTop hnv).comp hsq
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
    hbig.eventually_ge_atTop ⌈t₀ * (E 1 - E 0) / (2 * π)⌉₊] with δ hδ hq
  have hδ' : (0 : ℝ) < δ := hδ
  set r : ℝ := 1 / (4 * π) * Real.sqrt δ with hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    rw [hr]
    exact mul_pos (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hδ')
  set q : ℕ := firstHit (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ)) r with hqdef
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := one_le_firstHit _ hrpos
  have hmem := (firstHit_mem (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ)) hrpos).2
  have hδ8 : 8 * π ^ 2 * r ^ 2 < δ := by
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt δ ^ 2 = δ := Real.sq_sqrt hδ'.le
    rw [hr, mul_pow, hsqrt]
    have : 8 * π ^ 2 * ((1 / (4 * π)) ^ 2 * δ) = δ / 2 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [this]
    linarith
  have ht₀le : t₀ ≤ 2 * π * (q : ℝ) / (E 1 - E 0) := by
    have hceil : t₀ * (E 1 - E 0) / (2 * π) ≤ (⌈t₀ * (E 1 - E 0) / (2 * π)⌉₊ : ℝ) :=
      Nat.le_ceil _
    have hqR : ((⌈t₀ * (E 1 - E 0) / (2 * π)⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hg0]
    have h1 : t₀ * (E 1 - E 0) / (2 * π) ≤ (q : ℝ) := le_trans hceil hqR
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h1
    linarith
  exact fidelityReturnTime_le_of_windingReturn E p hp1 hpnn hg0 hrpos hδ8 hq1 hmem ht₀le

/-- **No fidelity return before the winding threshold.**  For a non-approximable projective gap
spectrum the first fidelity return after a positive cutoff is at least a fixed multiple of
`(1/δ)^{β/2}`, where `β` is the continuous winding exponent spoiled by `η`. -/

method.description: Establishes an upper bound on fidelity return time using a limit argument and first hit properties
steps: applies tendsto_firstHit_atTop to bound first hit
uses positivity and sqrt to define r and establish r > 0
shows t₀ ≤ 2 * π * q / (E 1 - E 0) via ceiling and first hit inequality
evidence: set q : ℕ := firstHit (anchoredGapRatioMap E 0 1 (fun k => k.succ.succ)) r with hqdef
have ht₀le : t₀ ≤ 2 * π * (q : ℝ) / (E 1 - E 0) := by

theorem observerPhaseEnergy_virtualFidelity_comparable
    {d e : ℕ} {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (lam : J → ℝ) (block : J → Fin d → Fin d → ℂ)
    (hlam : ∀ a, 0 ≤ lam a) (energy : Fin d → ℝ)
    (q : Fin (e + 2) ≃
      graphNonRoot (finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block))
    (sigma : ℝ) (hsigma : sigma = 1 ∨ sigma = -1) :
    ∃ A B : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      A * GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.spectralReturnDeficit
          (observerVirtualEnergy (finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block)
            energy q sigma) (observerVirtualWeight e) t ≤
        finiteQuantumObserverPhaseEnergy lam
          (finiteObserverHamiltonianVertexPhase t energy) block ∧
      finiteQuantumObserverPhaseEnergy lam
          (finiteObserverHamiltonianVertexPhase t energy) block ≤
        B * GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.spectralReturnDeficit
          (observerVirtualEnergy (finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block)
            energy q sigma) (observerVirtualWeight e) t
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem observerPhaseEnergy_virtualFidelity_comparable
    {d e : ℕ} {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (lam : J → ℝ) (block : J → Fin d → Fin d → ℂ)
    (hlam : ∀ a, 0 ≤ lam a) (energy : Fin d → ℝ)
    (q : Fin (e + 2) ≃
      graphNonRoot (finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block))
    (sigma : ℝ) (hsigma : sigma = 1 ∨ sigma = -1) :
    ∃ A B : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      A * GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.spectralReturnDeficit
          (observerVirtualEnergy (finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block)
            energy q sigma) (observerVirtualWeight e) t ≤
        finiteQuantumObserverPhaseEnergy lam
          (finiteObserverHamiltonianVertexPhase t energy) block ∧
      finiteQuantumObserverPhaseEnergy lam
          (finiteObserverHamiltonianVertexPhase t energy) block ≤
        B * GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.spectralReturnDeficit
          (observerVirtualEnergy (finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block)
            energy q sigma) (observerVirtualWeight e) t
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let G := finiteObserverCoherenceGraph lam block
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hmetric⟩ :=
    observerPhaseEnergy_rootChordEnergy_comparable lam block hlam
  let c : ℝ := (observerVirtualWeight e 0 / 2) * (1 / (e + 3 : ℝ))
  let C : ℝ := 2 * (1 / (e + 3 : ℝ))
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    simp only [c, observerVirtualWeight]
    positivity
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    dsimp [C]
    positivity
  refine ⟨a / C, b / c, div_pos ha hC, div_pos hb hc, ?_⟩
  intro t
  let z := finiteObserverHamiltonianVertexPhase t energy
  have hz : ∀ i, ‖z i‖ = 1 :=
    finiteObserverHamiltonianVertexPhase_norm t energy
  have hm := hmetric z hz
  have hpivot := observerVirtualPivotEnergy_eq_rootChordEnergy
    G energy q sigma t hsigma
  have hf := observerVirtualFidelityDeficit_pivot_comparable
    G energy q sigma t
  let reference := GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.spectralReturnDeficit
    (observerVirtualEnergy G energy q sigma) (observerVirtualWeight e) t
  let root := graphRootChordEnergy G z
  let signal := finiteQuantumObserverPhaseEnergy lam z block
  change projectiveWeightedPivotEnergy (observerVirtualWeight e)
      (spectralReturnPhase (observerVirtualEnergy G energy q sigma) t) 0 =
    (1 / (e + 3 : ℝ)) * root at hpivot
  rw [hpivot] at hf
  have hrootref : c * root ≤ reference ∧ reference ≤ C * root := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [c, root, reference, mul_assoc] using hf.1
    · simpa only [C, root, reference, mul_assoc] using hf.2
  constructor
  · calc
      (a / C) * reference ≤ (a / C) * (C * root) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrootref.2 (div_nonneg ha.le hC.le)
      _ = a * root := by field_simp
      _ ≤ signal := hm.1
  · calc
      signal ≤ b * root := hm.2
      _ = (b / c) * (c * root) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ (b / c) * reference :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrootref.1 (div_nonneg hb.le hc.le)

theorem gammaClockCurvature_factorization_unique_up_to_scale
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (source : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) (boundary : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hfactor : ∀ a i, gammaClockCurvature n a i = source a * boundary i) :
    ∃! c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      source = (fun a ↦ c * a (Fin.last n)) ∧
      boundary = (fun i ↦ c⁻¹ * gammaClockBoundaryVector n i)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem gammaClockCurvature_factorization_unique_up_to_scale
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (source : (Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) → ℂ) (boundary : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hfactor : ∀ a i, gammaClockCurvature n a i = source a * boundary i) :
    ∃! c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      source = (fun a ↦ c * a (Fin.last n)) ∧
      boundary = (fun i ↦ c⁻¹ * gammaClockBoundaryVector n i)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let anchor : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ := Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1
  have hsourceAnchor : anchor (Fin.last n) ≠ 0 := by
    simp [anchor]
  let boundaryAnchor : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  have hboundaryAnchor : gammaClockBoundaryVector n boundaryAnchor ≠ 0 := by
    simp [gammaClockBoundaryVector, boundaryAnchor, Nat.factorial_ne_zero]
  apply sharedClockObservation_factorization_unique_up_to_scale
    (fun a : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ ↦ a (Fin.last n)) source
    (gammaClockBoundaryVector n) boundary anchor boundaryAnchor
    hsourceAnchor hboundaryAnchor
  funext a i
  simp only [sharedClockObservation]
  calc
    a (Fin.last n) * gammaClockBoundaryVector n i =
        gammaClockCurvature n a i := by
      symm
      simpa only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using
        congrFun (gammaClockCurvature_eq_outerProduct n a) i
    _ = source a * boundary i := hfactor a i

      ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a u=(r:ℂ) • u ∧ ccmPolarBoundarySourceFunctional a u ≠ 0

by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hne⟩ := exists_reflected_source_ne_zero a hr
  let u := v+(r:ℂ) • ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a v
  have hu : IsPolarConstrained a u :=
    (ccmPolarConstraintSubmodule a).add_mem hv ((ccmPolarConstraintSubmodule a).smul_mem _ hv.reflection)
  have hpar : ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a u=(r:ℂ) • u := by
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl
    · change ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a (v+(1:ℂ) • ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a v)=

      simp only [one_smul,map_add,ccmArchimedeanFormReflection_involutive]
      abel
    · change ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a (v+((-1:ℝ):ℂ) • ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a v)=
        ((-1:ℝ):ℂ) • (v+((-1:ℝ):ℂ) • ccmArchimedeanFormReflection a v)

    _ = first.support * second.inverse := by rw [first.inverse_mul_metric]
    _ = second.support * second.inverse := by
      rw [symmetricSupportInverse_support_unique T first second]
    _ = second.inverse := second.support_mul_inverse

by
  by_contra hnotle
  have habslt :
      LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv
          (xiRectangularWeilTailNegativeDirichletCoefficient L N) <
        ((1 + xiRightTransverseSup : ℝ) : EReal) :=
    lt_of_not_ge hnotle
  have hne : Nonempty XiRightZeroCopy :=
    nonempty_xiRightZeroCopy_of_not_riemannHypothesis hnot
  have hone : ((1 : ℝ) : EReal) <

    exact_mod_cast (by linarith [xiRightTransverseSup_pos hne] :

  have hmax :

          ((1 : ℝ) : EReal) <
        ((1 + xiRightTransverseSup : ℝ) : EReal) :=
    max_lt habslt hone

    EReal.exists_between_coe_real hmax
  have habsSigma :
      LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv
          (xiRectangularWeilTailNegativeDirichletCoefficient L N) <
        (sigma : EReal) :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hmaxSigma
  have honeSigma : (1 : ℝ) < sigma := by
    exact_mod_cast ((le_max_right
      (LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv
        (xiRectangularWeilTailNegativeDirichletCoefficient L N))
      ((1 : ℝ) : EReal)).trans_lt hmaxSigma)
  have hsigmaTransverse : sigma < 1 + xiRightTransverseSup := by
    exact_mod_cast hsigmaBelow
  have hsum : LSeriesSummable
      (xiRectangularWeilTailNegativeDirichletCoefficient L N)
      (sigma : ℂ) :=
    LSeriesSummable_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt_re (by
      simpa only [ofReal_re] using habsSigma)

    hL hN honeSigma hsigmaTransverse) hsum

    (hODE : ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
      MvPolynomial.eval (odeJet f n z) S * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f z
        = MvPolynomial.eval (odeJet f n z) N)
    (hSne : ∃ z₀ ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, MvPolynomial.eval (odeJet f n z₀) S ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (z₁ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ), z₁ ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 ∧ 0 < δ ∧ 1 - ‖z₁‖ < δ ∧
      ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g (ball z₁ δ) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ ball z₁ δ ∩ ball (0 : ℂ) 1, g z = f z

by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hS0⟩ := hSne
  have hgSdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => MvPolynomial.eval (odeJet f n z) S)
      (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := differentiableOn_evalJet hf S
  set ε : ℝ := ‖MvPolynomial.eval (odeJet f n z₀) S‖ with hεdef
  have hε0 : 0 < ε := norm_pos_iff.mpr hS0
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hjet z₀ hz₀)
  obtain ⟨LS, hLS0, hLS⟩ :=
    exists_lipschitz_mvPolynomial_eval S (0 : Fin (n + 2) → ℂ) (M + 1)
  set ρ' : ℝ := min 1 (ε / (2 * (LS + 1))) with hρ'def
  have hρ'0 : 0 < ρ' := lt_min one_pos (by positivity)
  have hρ'1 : ρ' ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  obtain ⟨MΦ, LΦ, hMΦ0, hLΦ0, hMΦ, hLΦ⟩ :=
    exists_bound_lipschitz_companionVec n N S (M + 1) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  set δ : ℝ := min 1 (min (ρ' / (2 * (MΦ + 1))) (1 / (2 * (LΦ + 1)))) with hδdef
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := lt_min one_pos (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _

    have h1 : δ ≤ ρ' / (2 * (MΦ + 1)) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 : δ * MΦ ≤ (ρ' / (2 * (MΦ + 1))) * MΦ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hMΦ0
    have h3 : (ρ' / (2 * (MΦ + 1))) * MΦ < ρ' := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [hρ'0, hMΦ0]
    linarith
  have hδL : δ * LΦ < 1 := by
    have h1 : δ ≤ 1 / (2 * (LΦ + 1)) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h2 : δ * LΦ ≤ (1 / (2 * (LΦ + 1))) * LΦ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hLΦ0
    have h3 : (1 / (2 * (LΦ + 1))) * LΦ < 1 := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [hLΦ0]
    linarith
  -- choose the radius
  have hz₀norm : ‖z₀‖ < 1 := by
    have := mem_ball.mp hz₀
    rwa [dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] at this
  set r : ℝ := max ((‖z₀‖ + 1) / 2) (1 - δ / 2) with hrdef
  have hr0 : ‖z₀‖ < r := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hr1 : r < 1 := max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hr2 : 1 - r < δ := by
    have : 1 - δ / 2 ≤ r := le_max_right _ _
    linarith
  obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁norm, hz₁ge⟩ := exists_norm_ge_on_sphere hgSdiff hr0 hr1
  have hz₁ball : z₁ ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero, hz₁norm]
    exact hr1

  have hw₁norm : ‖w₁‖ ≤ M := hjet z₁ hz₁ball
  have hSz₁ : ε ≤ ‖MvPolynomial.eval w₁ S‖ := hz₁ge

    intro v hv
    have hvw : ‖v - w₁‖ < ρ' := by
      have := mem_ball.mp hv
      rwa [dist_eq_norm] at this
    have hvnorm : ‖v‖ ≤ M + 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖v‖ - ‖w₁‖ ≤ ‖v - w₁‖ := norm_sub_norm_le v w₁
      linarith
    refine ⟨hvnorm, ?_⟩
    have hvmem : v ∈ closedBall (0 : Fin (n + 2) → ℂ) (M + 1) := by

  have h16 : (0 : ℝ) < (16 : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity

    (q : ℕ) {rho : ℂ} (hrhoRe : 0 < rho.re)
    (hrho1 : rho ≠ 1) (hzeta : riemannZeta rho = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, eulerDeletionWeightedJump q rho n)

    (q : ℕ) {rho : ℂ} (hrhoRe : 0 < rho.re)

  have hconv := eulerDeletionDirichlet_convergesAt (q := q) (s := rho) hrhoRe

    (eulerDeletionDirichletCoefficient q) rho = 0 at hzero
  rw [hzero] at ht
  simpa [GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.dirichletPartialSum,
    eulerDeletionWeightedJump, eulerDeletionDirichletSum] using ht

    (hdat : ∀ α, Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => F α ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      / gammaShiftShape lam σ (d α) (ω α) (b α) t) atTop (nhds (c α)))
    (hrel : ∀ s : ℂ,

by
  classical
  set A : ℕ → ℂ := fun _ => 1 with hAdef
  set freq : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => Real.log ((i : ℝ) + 1) with hfreqdef
  set f : ℝ →ᵇ ℂ := zetaLine hσ with hfdef
  have hconv : ∀ r' : ℝ, r' < R → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ closedStrip σ r',
      ‖riemannZeta z - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n₀,
        A i * Complex.exp (-(freq i : ℂ) * z)‖ ≤ ε := zeta_dirichlet_conv hRσ
  have hD : DifferentiableOn ℂ riemannZeta (verticalStrip σ R) := by
    intro z hz
    have habs : |z.re - σ| < R := hz
    have h1 : σ - R < z.re := by
      have := (abs_lt.mp habs).1
      linarith
    have hne : z ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at h1
      simp at h1
      linarith
    exact (differentiableAt_riemannZeta hne).differentiableWithinAt
  have hfval : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = riemannZeta ((σ : ℂ) + (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) := fun _ => rfl
  have hfcont : Continuous fun x : ℝ => f x := continuous_zeta_line hσ
  have hap : IsStripAlmostPeriodic riemannZeta σ R :=
    isStripAlmostPeriodic_dirichlet A freq riemannZeta hconv
  have hline : _root_.HTGeometry.IsBohrAlmostPeriodic
      fun t : ℝ => riemannZeta ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := isBohrAlmostPeriodic_line hR hap
  have hfap : _root_.HTGeometry.IsBohrAlmostPeriodic fun x : ℝ => f x := hline
  have hfu : UniformContinuous fun x : ℝ => f x :=
    uniformContinuous_of_isBohrAlmostPeriodic hfcont hfap
  have hftb : HasTotallyBoundedOrbit fun x : ℝ => f x :=
    hasTotallyBoundedOrbit_of_isBohrAlmostPeriodic hfcont hfap
  have hrank : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ idx : Fin (K + 1) → ℕ, (∀ i, A (idx i) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (K + 1), ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n₀ : ℕ, idx i < n₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
        ‖riemannZeta ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          - ∑ i' ∈ Finset.range n₀,
            A i' * Complex.exp (-(freq i' : ℂ) * ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤ ε) ∧
      LinearIndependent ℤ (fun i : Fin (K + 1) => -(freq (idx i))) := by
    intro K
    refine ⟨fun i => nthPrimeIndex (i : ℕ), fun _ => one_ne_zero, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i ε hε
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := zeta_uniform_approx (c := σ) hσ hε
      refine ⟨max M (nthPrimeIndex (i : ℕ) + 1), lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
        (le_max_right _ _), fun t => ?_⟩
      exact hM _ (le_max_left _ _) _ (by simp)
    · have hfun : (fun i : Fin (K + 1) => -(freq (nthPrimeIndex (i : ℕ))))
          = fun i : Fin (K + 1) => -(Real.log ((Nat.nth Nat.Prime (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        funext i
        rw [hfreqdef]
        simp only
        rw [nthPrimeIndex_cast]
      rw [hfun]
      exact linearIndependent_neg_log_firstPrimes K
  exact dirichlet_no_gammaShift_relation hlam hN hr hρ hrρ hR A freq riemannZeta
    zetaFrequency_injective hD hconv hfval hfu hftb hrank e he F d ω b c hc hdat hrel

theorem generalizedDirichletSeries_coeff_eq_zero_of_eventuallyEq_zero
    {mu : ℕ → ℝ} (hmu : StrictMono mu) (hmu0 : 0 < mu 0)
    {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)

theorem generalizedDirichletSeries_coeff_eq_zero_of_eventuallyEq_zero
    {mu : ℕ → ℝ} (hmu : StrictMono mu) (hmu0 : 0 < mu 0)
    {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hzero : (fun x : ℝ => generalizedDirichletSeries mu a x) =ᶠ[atTop] 0) :
    ∀ n, a n = 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
      have hscaledZero :
          (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (mu n * x) : ℂ) *
            generalizedDirichletSeries mu a x) =ᶠ[atTop] 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hzero] with x hx
        simp [hx]
      have ht := generalizedDirichletSeries_tendsto_scaled hmu hmu0 ha
        (k := n) (fun m hm => ih m hm)
      have ht0 : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) atTop (𝓝 (a n)) :=
        ht.congr' hscaledZero
      have hz : (0 : ℂ) = a n := by
        simpa only [tendsto_const_nhds_iff] using ht0
      exact hz.symm
